descriptionHtml:
RevolutionParts is not just a pioneering force in the automotive eCommerce realm; we're actively seeking passionate and talented individuals to join our squad of Revolutionaries (yes, that's what we call ourselves!). As leaders in providing streamlined, user-friendly solutions, we empower automotive brands to maximize online sales. Our commitment to technology, top-notch customer service, and a profound understanding of the automotive market sets us apart. If you're ready to revolutionize the eCommerce space for automotive parts and accessories, consider joining our dynamic team of Revolutionaries.

AI Fluency & Modern Tooling

At RevolutionParts, we expect team members to actively use modern tools — including AI-powered systems — to improve decision-making, productivity, and quality of work.

This Includes

  • Using AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving
  • Exercising strong judgment around data privacy, accuracy, and ethical use
  • Continuously learning and adapting as AI capabilities evolve

Proven examples of using AI to improve outcomes in prior roles is expected.

The Role

RevolutionParts is an automotive eCommerce platform. AI is raising both the speed and the complexity of attacks and of vulnerability discovery, and we intend to meet that pace with AI of our own. Our CloudOps team is becoming a CloudSecOps team, and we are hiring a security engineer who puts AI at the center of the work to continuously find where we are exposed, set up the systems and practices that keep us secure, and help the people around you get better at security.

What this role is: analysis, prevention, and the delegation of work. You will find and prove our weaknesses across cloud, applications, and third-party tools, rank them by real risk, and get them to the right owner. This role does not take on day-to-day CloudOps requests or the infrastructure on-call rotation; the CloudOps team keeps that work.

How AI fits: we expect you to lean hard on AI. Use AI-assisted scanning, code review, and triage to find issues faster than a person could, automate the repeat work, and set up guardrails and detection so the program runs on a steady rhythm. You will also define how our engineers use AI safely.

You guide teams through the fixes that belong to them; you do not take on the work in their stack. You will write code of your own, though: scripts, automation, detections, and security tooling, much of it built with AI. Much of the job is coordination: chasing down answers, getting the right people in a room, and following up with stakeholders and owners until the work is done. This is not a role that writes a report and moves on. You find the problem, get it to the right owner, and stay on it until it is fixed.

What you will do

Find and prove

  • Run AI-assisted scanning of our code, infrastructure, and cloud configuration, and triage the results into real, ranked findings
  • Test our applications the way an attacker would, through pentesting and ethical hacking, with a focus on business logic flaws in checkout, account, and payment flows
  • Run quarterly access reviews, and ensure that SSO and MFA stays consistent across the SaaS tools we manage
  • Review our AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code setup for weaknesses in identity, encryption, secrets, and network controls, and hand clear, prioritized fixes to the owning teams
  • Own our pentest and bug bounty work: scope it, triage what comes in, give each finding an owner and a severity-based deadline, and verify every fix
  • Set our edge security policy as we modernize: WAF and bot management (letting search engines and approved AI crawlers through while blocking malicious bots), TLS, DNS, and certificates

Operate and respond

  • Watch AWS security signals and our SIEM and EDR; keep endpoint coverage complete across servers, clusters, and devices; and lead the security side of incidents alongside our incident commander
  • Get full value from the security tools we already have, starting with our SIEM: bring in the right data sources, build and tune detections, cut noise, and show leadership what each tool delivers
  • Own code security day-to-day in GitHub and our code analysis tools: dependency alerts, code and secret scanning, quality gates on pull requests, branch protection, and repository access, with findings routed to the right teams
  • Help design and run tabletop exercises with the infrastructure team, owning the security scenarios
  • Coordinate our response when a widely exploited vulnerability hits (think Log4Shell), drive patching to completion, and document risk acceptance when we choose not to patch
  • Keep our compliance work (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, security questionnaires, partner assessments, quarterly PCI ASV scans, and the Trust Center) on schedule, and use AI and a compliance platform to automate evidence collection and questionnaire drafting so it stays a small share of your time
  • Keep our contractual security obligations visible and our security processes documented
  • Define how engineers use AI safely: what data can and cannot go to AI tools, prompt-injection risks, and how to review AI-generated security suggestions
  • Set best practices for handling PII and route them to the teams that own each system

Prevent

  • Build guardrails so issues do not come back: policy-as-code, organization-level controls, and security checks in CI/CD and GitHub
  • Mature detection and incident readiness, including runbooks and response playbooks
  • Defend against AI-accelerated attacks: shorten the time from a disclosed vulnerability to a verified fix, harden identity and email against AI-written phishing and impersonation, detect automated credential and bot abuse, and help shape the roadmap for where we invest next
  • Evaluate security tools from the major vendors and automate recurring scans, ticket creation, and reporting

What success looks like

Strong cloud security teams measure outcomes, not activity. Here is how we will know this role is working.

Early on

  • You know our environment end to end and have a risk-ranked plan the team agrees on
  • AI-assisted scanning runs on a regular schedule and produces triaged findings, not raw noise
  • Every open security finding has an owner, a severity, and a due date

Over time

  • Vulnerabilities are fixed within severity-based timelines, internet-facing critical issues first, and exceptions are documented as risk acceptances; the time from a public exploit to our fix keeps shrinking as attackers get faster
  • Security controls live in code, and guardrails catch misconfigurations before they reach production, so fewer new findings appear each quarter
  • Our security tools earn their cost: the right data flows into the SIEM, detections are tuned, and time to detect and respond keeps improving
  • Audits, scans, partner assessments, and questionnaires are completed on time with evidence ready, not in a scramble
  • Incident runbooks are tested in tabletop exercises and improved after every incident
  • Leadership gets a regular, plain-language view of security risk and trends, and application teams bring security questions to you early
  • The CloudSecOps team and engineering teams handle more security work on their own, because you have helped them learn how

What you bring

  • 5+ years in cloud, infrastructure, application, or security engineering, with recent years focused on security
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, especially AWS: IAM, encryption, logging, network controls, and native security services, enough to find flaws and guide the fix
  • Able to read infrastructure as code (Terraform) and spot security misconfigurations, and comfortable scripting in Python, Bash, or similar to automate scans, detections, and reporting
  • A track record of driving security remediation: pentest and scan findings, patching, and widely exploited vulnerabilities, driven to verified closure across teams
  • Experience in SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS environments at an eCommerce company or a high-traffic SaaS platform: access reviews, audit evidence, questionnaires, and third-party assessments, including working with auditors
  • Experience with vulnerability management and incident response
  • Application security testing experience (pentesting or ethical hacking), especially business logic flaws in web apps; strongly preferred
  • Hands-on use of AI in security work, such as AI-assisted scanning, triage, or code review, with a clear view of how to use AI safely
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Security+, or equivalent strongly preferred
  • Excellent written communication skills; comfortable writing clear, accurate responses for customer-facing security documentation
  • Hands-on experience running a SIEM and EDR: building and tuning detections, investigating alerts, and leading incident response
  • Strong follow-through, clear writing, and a habit of teaching: you work independently, help others grow, use AI tools daily, and learn and unlearn quickly, letting go of tools and habits that AI or new threats have made obsolete

Nice to have

  • EDR, WAF, and bot management platforms
  • Kubernetes (EKS) and container security
  • Building preventive guardrails: policy-as-code, AWS organization controls, and security checks in CI
  • Secrets management with HashiCorp Vault or similar, and Zero Trust remote access
  • A compliance automation platform such as Vanta, Drata, or Delve, plus GitHub security features and static analysis tools
  • Writing Terraform
  • Working with AI to build in house security tooling to assist in the awareness and remediation of security vulnerabilities
  • Security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, Security+, CISSP, or similar)

If you meet most of what is listed here and the work excites you, we would like to hear from you.

Why RevolutionParts

  • Autonomy: you decide how we find our weaknesses and how we prevent them
  • Build the function: help turn CloudOps into CloudSecOps and shape how security works here
  • AI tooling: we are AI-first, and you will have room to build how we use AI to find and prevent security problems
  • Real impact: your work protects a high-traffic eCommerce platform that automotive businesses and their customers rely on every day
  • Mentor and grow others: raise the security skills of the engineers you work with
  • A real bias for action: we make decisions quickly and ship; good ideas do not wait months for approval
  • Please note that this is a hybrid role that requires that you work from our Tempe, Arizona, offices at least 2 days per week.

RevolutionParts is proud to provide all full-time Revolutionaries with a comprehensive employment package including competitive compensation, career development, benefits, 401K match, parental leave, and many more valuable perks. You can learn more about our core-value driven culture at our career page.

RevolutionParts is an Equal Opportunity Employer; we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender orientation, gender identity or expression, sexual identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, family status, genetic information, veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: You will only receive correspondence through the Gem ATS or from a @revolutionparts.com email address. If you are receiving communication through any other platform or domain, it may be fraudulent, and we urge you to ignore the communication.

- Security controls live in code, and guardrails catch misconfigurations before they reach production, so fewer new findings appear each quarter
- Our security tools earn their cost: the right data flows into the SIEM, detections are tuned, and time to detect and respond keeps improving
- Audits, scans, partner assessments, and questionnaires are completed on time with evidence ready, not in a scramble
- Incident runbooks are tested in tabletop exercises and improved after every incident
- Leadership gets a regular, plain-language view of security risk and trends, and application teams bring security questions to you early
- The CloudSecOps team and engineering teams handle more security work on their own, because you have helped them learn how

What you bring



- 5+ years in cloud, infrastructure, application, or security engineering, with recent years focused on security
- Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, especially AWS: IAM, encryption, logging, network controls, and native security services, enough to find flaws and guide the fix
- Able to read infrastructure as code (Terraform) and spot security misconfigurations, and comfortable scripting in Python, Bash, or similar to automate scans, detections, and reporting
- A track record of driving security remediation: pentest and scan findings, patching, and widely exploited vulnerabilities, driven to verified closure across teams
- Experience in SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS environments at an eCommerce company or a high-traffic SaaS platform: access reviews, audit evidence, questionnaires, and third-party assessments, including working with auditors
- Experience with vulnerability management and incident response
- Application security testing experience (pentesting or ethical hacking), especially business logic flaws in web apps; strongly preferred
- Hands-on use of AI in security work, such as AI-assisted scanning, triage, or code review, with a clear view of how to use AI safely
- Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Security+, or equivalent strongly preferred
- Excellent written communication skills; comfortable writing clear, accurate responses for customer-facing security documentation
- Hands-on experience running a SIEM and EDR: building and tuning detections, investigating alerts, and leading incident response
- Strong follow-through, clear writing, and a habit of teaching: you work independently, help others grow, use AI tools daily, and learn and unlearn quickly, letting go of tools and habits that AI or new threats have made obsolete

Nice to have



- EDR, WAF, and bot management platforms
- Kubernetes (EKS) and container security
- Building preventive guardrails: policy-as-code, AWS organization controls, and security checks in CI
- Secrets management with HashiCorp Vault or similar, and Zero Trust remote access
- A compliance automation platform such as Vanta, Drata, or Delve, plus GitHub security features and static analysis tools
- Writing Terraform
- Working with AI to build in house security tooling to assist in the awareness and remediation of security vulnerabilities
- Security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, Security+, CISSP, or similar)

If you meet most of what is listed here and the work excites you, we would like to hear from you.

- Build the function: help turn CloudOps into CloudSecOps and shape how security works here

Summary/Objective

  • Designs, implements, administers, and continuously improves enterprise cybersecurity technologies and technical controls, including endpoint protection, endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity security, email security, cloud security, network security, vulnerability management, and security monitoring platforms.
  • Monitors, investigates, and responds to cybersecurity alerts, events, and incidents by performing technical analysis, containment, remediation, recovery, evidence preservation, and root-cause analysis in coordination with the Cybersecurity Manager and other technology teams.
  • Leads the technical execution of the vulnerability management program by identifying and validating vulnerabilities, evaluating risk and exploitability, coordinating remediation with system owners, verifying corrective actions, and maintaining accurate remediation records and reporting.
  • Engineers and maintains security controls for Identity and Access Management (IAM), privileged access, authentication, access reviews, and identity threat protection while partnering with IT Operations and Systems Administration on identity lifecycle administration and operational support.
  • Conducts security architecture reviews and technical risk assessments for infrastructure, cloud services, applications, vendors, acquisitions, and strategic technology initiatives, documenting findings and recommending practical risk-reduction measures.
  • Develops and maintains cybersecurity configurations, technical standards, operating procedures, playbooks, diagrams, documentation, and automation that support consistent security operations, incident response, regulatory compliance, and effective knowledge transfer.
  • Supports internal and external security assessments, audits, customer security reviews, and compliance activities by validating control implementation, gathering technical evidence, addressing findings, and assisting with remediation plans aligned with HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST, PCI DSS, and other applicable requirements.
  • Serves as a senior technical cybersecurity resource for the Cybersecurity team and the broader Information Technology organization by providing technical leadership, mentoring Security Administrators and IT staff, promoting cross-training and knowledge sharing, supporting cybersecurity training and awareness initiatives, evaluating emerging threats and technologies, and recommending continuous improvements to Envision Radiology's overall security posture.
  • Performs other duties as assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Competencies

  • Cybersecurity Engineering
  • Security Architecture
  • Incident Response
  • Risk & Vulnerability Management
  • Security Compliance
  • Technical Problem Solving
  • Communication
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no supervision responsibilities.

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel or operate objects, tools or controls, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to talk and hear.

Travel

Minimal travel is expected for this position.

Job Qualifications

Job Qualifications/Experience:

  • Five (5) or more years of progressively responsible experience in cybersecurity, information security, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and administering enterprise cybersecurity technologies across endpoint, identity, cloud, email, network, vulnerability management, and security monitoring environments.
  • Experience leading technical incident response activities, security investigations, containment, remediation, recovery, and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience performing security architecture reviews, technical risk assessments, and security control evaluations.
  • Experience supporting internal and external security audits, regulatory assessments, customer security reviews, and compliance activities.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft enterprise technologies, including Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Active Directory, Azure, virtualization platforms, and cloud services.
  • Experience scripting or automating cybersecurity and administrative tasks using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies preferred.
  • Experience supporting healthcare or another highly regulated industry preferred.
  • Ability to communicate technical risks, findings, and recommendations effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, documentation, and presentation skills.

Education/Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • One or more of the following certifications preferred: CISSP, GSEC, GCED, Security+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300), CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator, or other relevant cloud, networking, or cybersecurity vendor certifications.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

None required for this position.

Compliance

Adheres to Envision’s Code of Conduct and Compliance Policies and attends annual Compliance training as set forth by the Company.

Company Benefits

The following benefit programs are available to eligible employees. Benefits eligibility is dependent on a variety of factors, including employee classification.

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Company Matched 401k Plan
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan
  • Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

OSHA Exposure Rating: 1

It is reasonably anticipated NO employees in this job classification will have occupational exposure to blood and other potentially infectious body fluids. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.

descriptionHtml:
Direct Supply is building the future of healthcare technology with industry-leading products, solutions and platforms to help improve the lives of millions of seniors and those who care for them.

The Senior Cyber Security Engineer plays a critical role in identifying, assessing and reducing cybersecurity risks across Direct Supply’s technology environments. This role provides hands-on technical expertise and operational ownership of vulnerability management and penetration testing to strengthen security controls, reduce exposure and protect business systems and information.

Reporting to the Director of Information Security, you’ll work independently and collaborate with engineering, operations and security teams to drive effective remediation, improve security processes and deliver measurable improvements in Direct Supply’s security posture.

What You’ll Do And Impact

  • Own vulnerability management operations by establishing effective processes, maintaining security scanning tools and ensuring reliable coverage across infrastructure, cloud and application environments to identify and reduce security exposure.
  • Analyze and prioritize security vulnerabilities by validating findings and assessing exploitability, asset criticality and business impact to focus remediation efforts on the highest risks.
  • Drive vulnerability remediation by partnering with engineering and operations teams to coordinate corrective actions, monitor progress, verify fixes and escalate unresolved risks.
  • Improve security processes by automating scanning, ticketing and reporting workflows to increase efficiency, strengthen consistency and reduce manual effort.
  • Monitor and report security performance through metrics on scanning coverage, remediation progress, overdue vulnerabilities and recurring risks to improve visibility and support informed decisions.
  • Plan and execute internal and external penetration testing by defining assessment scope, conducting security testing and identifying exploitable weaknesses to strengthen security defenses.
  • Validate security weaknesses and potential attack paths through automated discovery, manual testing and controlled exploitation to assess business impact and deliver actionable findings.
  • Coordinate external penetration testing services by managing testing scope, schedules, access and deliverables while monitoring provider performance to ensure effective testing coverage and quality.
  • Drive resolution of penetration testing findings by validating results, providing remediation guidance, coordinating corrective actions and retesting fixes to confirm vulnerabilities have been addressed.
  • Strengthen security practices by analyzing root causes, recommending improvements to system designs and configurations, and sharing technical knowledge to prevent recurring vulnerabilities.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security or a related field.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience in information security or security engineering, including hands-on experience in vulnerability management and penetration testing.
  • Demonstrated expertise in vulnerability assessment, security scanning platforms, asset coverage, finding validation and risk-based prioritization to identify and reduce security exposure.
  • Hands-on experience conducting internal and external penetration testing, including manual validation, controlled exploitation, security risk assessment and technical reporting.
  • Experience operating, configuring and troubleshooting security platforms and automating security workflows to improve operational efficiency and testing effectiveness.
  • Experience assessing vulnerabilities and security risks across infrastructure, cloud and application environments, including complex cloud environments.
  • Ability to independently investigate complex security issues, identify root causes and recommend practical corrective actions that reduce recurring risks.
  • Experience coordinating external security testing providers and communicating technical findings, remediation priorities and security risks to technical stakeholders and leadership.
  • OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT or relevant vulnerability management certifications; scripting and API integration experience; and experience testing web applications, APIs and cloud environments preferred.

Job to be performed in the location listed. Generous benefit package available.

descriptionHtml:
Healthcare is complex. We’re here to change that.

RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.

Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.

AT A GLANCE

As part of our RVO Health Security team, you will play a major part in strategic initiatives that improve our security posture and protect our sensitive data. You will work in a collaborative Agile environment, working closely with the business, IT, and engineering teams. You will apply your skills in a highly dynamic, innovative, cloud-native environment with a strong security-minded culture.

Where You'll Be

Location: Minneapolis, MN | Hybrid

We believe great collaboration happens when we're together, solving problems, learning from each other, and connecting as a team. That's why we’re in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week. You are welcome to work remotely Mondays and Fridays if you wish.

Address: 11000 Optum Cir Eden Prairie, MN 55344

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls and architectures to protect the company's cloud infrastructure, applications, and data from cyber threats.
  • Improve our cloud security posture and vulnerability management program — pull-request scanning, triage and tracking of findings to closure across engineering teams, and coverage and license optimization.
  • Build and enforce software supply chain controls across the developer toolchain — package, dependency, and extension guardrails, with enforcement thresholds tuned to reduce noise rather than generate it.
  • Extend security into CI/CD pipelines, including the emerging problem of governing AI-authored code at the pipeline chokepoint.
  • Build automation, internal tooling, and integrations against our developer platform and security stack so that security controls are self-service rather than ticket-driven.
  • Partner with Platform & Software Engineering teams to create visibility and awareness of security issues and work to prioritize their resolution in a collaborative way.
  • Perform security assessments, including code reviews and application security testing, to identify and mitigate risk in new and changing systems.
  • Participate in a weekly on-call rotation for managed detection and response escalations; investigate potential threats, respond to security incidents, and perform root cause analysis.
  • Develop and maintain security standard operating procedures and policies in accordance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, NIST CSF).
  • Stay informed of the latest developments in tactics, techniques, and procedures related to application and infrastructure vulnerabilities — especially in the healthcare space — and adapt the strategy or tooling to address new threats.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related field OR equivalent experience
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in application security, cloud security, or a related cybersecurity role.
  • Solid understanding of cloud security principles, architectures, and services (AWS or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud security posture management or CNAPP tooling (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud), and a track record of driving vulnerability findings to closure with engineering teams.
  • Experience building security automation, tooling, and integrations, with working proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language.
  • Working knowledge of secure coding practices.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks, standards, and regulations (e.g., NIST CSF, HIPAA, MITRE ATT&CK).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think critically and make sound decisions.
  • Experience in incident response and recovery.

Preferred

  • Professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GIAC).
  • Expertise in AWS security controls, monitoring, and orchestration (SCPs, GuardDuty, Config, Macie, etc.)
  • Working familiarity with Terraform, GitHub, and DevSecOps workflows — particularly securing GitHub Actions and other CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience securing AI- or LLM-assisted development workflows, or reviewing AI-generated code at scale.
  • Experience with internal developer platforms or portals (e.g., Backstage).
  • Experience working alongside an MDR or managed SOC provider.

Who We Are

RVO Health is a health-technology company created through a joint venture between Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group’s Optum. descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Most security roles end at the finding; this one starts there. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer who would rather close a gap than write a memo about it: someone who spots a misconfiguration, works out the right fix, and addresses it.

You will own hands-on security engineering across our hybrid environment: our AWS hosting platform, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, and Windows Server infrastructure. Your responsibilities also include running vulnerability and patch management and helping manage third-party risk. Reporting to the Vice President of Information Technology Operations, you will work across the organization, from the help desk to senior leadership.


What You Will Do

  • Find and fix real security issues across AWS, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, and Windows Server, not just report on them
  • Harden identity and access: Conditional Access, MFA, privileged access, and Microsoft 365 data governance, including how Copilot and shared content are exposed
  • Secure our AWS environment, from IAM and network controls to logging, encryption, and backup
  • Run vulnerability and patch management with a risk-based approach, and drive remediation to closure
  • Work with our managed detection and response partner to investigate alerts and respond to incidents
  • Work with a security vendor and a risk management program to address security findings and risk items: decide what matters most, then fix it
  • Automate repeatable work with PowerShell, Python, and infrastructure-as-code
  • Turn governance requirements and audit expectations into technical controls with evidence behind them
  • Assess and monitor third-party vendors, and help decide where the real risk is
  • Partner with staff across the organization to find secure ways to get their work done, offering practical solutions instead of just saying no


What Makes This Role Different

  • Ownership. You decide what to fix first, and you get to fix it.
  • Breadth. AWS, Microsoft 365, Windows infrastructure, vulnerability management, and third-party risk in one role, so no two weeks look the same.
  • Visibility. You work directly with technology leadership to reduce risk and demonstrate the results. Documentation supports that work; it is not the end goal.
  • A real mandate. Governance here means controls that are implemented and provable, not shelfware.


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in an IT or cybersecurity-related discipline, or 7 years of relevant experience or equivalent
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security or infrastructure engineering
  • Practical experience securing Microsoft 365 and Entra ID
  • Practical experience securing AWS environments
  • Strong grounding in Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy, with SQL Server and IIS exposure
  • Experience running vulnerability management and patching programs
  • Scripting ability in PowerShell and at least one of Python, AWS CLI, or infrastructure-as-code
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to explain risk to non-technical audiences


Nice to Have

  • Security certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, SC-300 or SC-200, CISSP, CISM, or CISA
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or ISO 27001
  • Experience with third-party risk management
  • Insurance industry experience

descriptionHtml:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will be responsible for protecting the credit union’s digital assets, sensitive customer information, and internal systems from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and managing security measures to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and systems. Responsibilities and expectations will scale according to the candidate's experience level

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.


Cybersecurity Engineer I Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security systems (SIEM/Endpoint Protection (AV, EDR, Zero Day, APT), DLP, IPS/IDS, NAC and rogue device detection) for suspicious activities and anomalies.
  • Respond to security incidents, conducting root cause analysis and coordinating remediation efforts.
  • Identify, analyze, and respond to security threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Perform threat hunting and advanced detection activities to protect systems and data.
  • Lead the planning, testing, and scheduling of system patches across all endpoints, mobile devices, servers, and network infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain a patch management schedule and ensure timely application of security patches and updates.
  • Coordinate with various teams to minimize disruption and ensure compatibility of patches with organizational systems.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing. Identify and prioritize risks, working with IT teams to remediate vulnerabilities and implement patches.
  • Design, implement, and manage security solutions, including firewalls, encryption protocols, access control systems, and data protection technologies.
  • Ensure compliance with regulations such as NCUA, PCI-DSS, and other applicable industry standards. Assist in audits, both internal and external, and provide reports and documentation as required.
  • Develop, document, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the organization’s cybersecurity posture.
  • Work closely with network, systems, and application teams to ensure security is integrated into the infrastructure. Support secure system and application development practices.
  • Assist in delivering cybersecurity training programs to staff, promoting awareness of security policies, phishing attacks, and safe computing practices.
  • Lead complex incident response efforts, coordinating with internal teams and external partners. Serve as the primary point of contact during high-impact security incidents.


Cybersecurity Engineer I Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. Relevant certifications and experience may substitute for a degree.
  • 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity.


Cybersecurity Engineer I Compensation

$99,000.00 - $139,734.00

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!


Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.


About SCCU

Since 1951, Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU) has proudly served our community, growing to over 685,000 members and managing $9 billion in assets. With 67 branches spanning Florida’s east coast, we are the third-largest credit union in the state. In 2025, we expanded into Orange County to better serve the growing East Orlando market.

As a not-for-profit financial institution, SCCU is dedicated to putting our members first. Unlike traditional banks, we return profits to our members through better rates, lower fees, and enhanced services. While we offer the same financial products—like checking, savings, and loans—our focus remains on empowering our members and supporting their financial well-being. With local decision-making and a commitment to exceptional service, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

At SCCU, we also prioritize our team members by fostering a supportive and collaborative environment that encourages career growth and development. As we continue to grow, we are seeking talented, member-focused professionals to join our team and help deliver innovative financial solutions and outstanding service.

descriptionHtml:
The Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer, Security to join our Platform Engineering team. This is a find-and-fix role. When you find a vulnerability in our infrastructure, you write the Terraform or the application change that closes it. Where the fix belongs to another team, you drive it to completion, with the CISO supporting you.

You will report into Platform Engineering and work closely with our CISO, who sets the security agenda and is your escalation route when remediation stalls elsewhere.

Responsibilities

  • Fix it, don't just find it: Remediate security findings across our infrastructure, writing the Terraform and application changes that close them. Where the fix belongs to another team, drive it to completion. Run vulnerability management from Snyk, Prowler, and ASV findings through to verified fixes.
  • Own AWS security: Cloud posture across IAM and least privilege, network boundaries, secrets management, and logging coverage. Define the technical security baselines new services are built to, covering host hardening, WAF configuration and deployment patterns, and enforce them as code.
  • Find problems before anyone else does: Regular penetration testing against our own environment, ahead of the formal annual assessment carried out by our external testers. Threat modelling and security review for new services early enough to change the design, including our integrations with payment and custody providers.
  • Respond when it matters: Serve as technical lead for security incidents, including forensic investigation. Own and improve detection coverage in Datadog, tuning alerts for signals.

What you need

  • Five or more years in hands-on security engineering, with responsibility for production systems.
  • You write and ship code. Terraform and Python, and enough application fluency to fix what you find rather than hand it off.
  • Deep AWS security experience, including IAM and least privilege at organization scale, and container workloads in ECS or EKS.
  • Application security, including threat modelling and hands-on offensive testing against cloud and application targets.
  • Security incident response, including forensic investigation.
  • You have run vulnerability management and driven fixes through teams you do not manage; you work the finding queue on your own initiative, without being chased.
  • You have worked in a regulated environment and turned ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or SOC 2 requirements into engineering work.
  • Detection engineering in Datadog, or a comparable SIEM.
  • Securing CI/CD pipelines, particularly GitHub Actions.
  • Cryptography and secrets management in practice, including key rotation and certificate lifecycle.
  • Using AI coding tools to remediate at scale, and reviewing AI-generated code with a security eye
  • Experience with payments, cards, or digital assets.

About Us

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

Here’s a Little More

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Taptap Values

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

descriptionHtml:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will be responsible for protecting the credit union’s digital assets, sensitive customer information, and internal systems from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and managing security measures to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and systems. Responsibilities and expectations will scale according to the candidate's experience level

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.


Cybersecurity Engineer I Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security systems (SIEM/Endpoint Protection (AV, EDR, Zero Day, APT), DLP, IPS/IDS, NAC and rogue device detection) for suspicious activities and anomalies.
  • Respond to security incidents, conducting root cause analysis and coordinating remediation efforts.
  • Identify, analyze, and respond to security threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Perform threat hunting and advanced detection activities to protect systems and data.
  • Lead the planning, testing, and scheduling of system patches across all endpoints, mobile devices, servers, and network infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain a patch management schedule and ensure timely application of security patches and updates.
  • Coordinate with various teams to minimize disruption and ensure compatibility of patches with organizational systems.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing. Identify and prioritize risks, working with IT teams to remediate vulnerabilities and implement patches.
  • Design, implement, and manage security solutions, including firewalls, encryption protocols, access control systems, and data protection technologies.
  • Ensure compliance with regulations such as NCUA, PCI-DSS, and other applicable industry standards. Assist in audits, both internal and external, and provide reports and documentation as required.
  • Develop, document, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the organization’s cybersecurity posture.
  • Work closely with network, systems, and application teams to ensure security is integrated into the infrastructure. Support secure system and application development practices.
  • Assist in delivering cybersecurity training programs to staff, promoting awareness of security policies, phishing attacks, and safe computing practices.
  • Lead complex incident response efforts, coordinating with internal teams and external partners. Serve as the primary point of contact during high-impact security incidents.


Cybersecurity Engineer I Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. Relevant certifications and experience may substitute for a degree.
  • 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity.


Cybersecurity Engineer I Compensation

$99,000.00 - $139,734.00

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!


Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.


About SCCU

Since 1951, Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU) has proudly served our community, growing to over 685,000 members and managing $9 billion in assets. With 67 branches spanning Florida’s east coast, we are the third-largest credit union in the state. In 2025, we expanded into Orange County to better serve the growing East Orlando market.

As a not-for-profit financial institution, SCCU is dedicated to putting our members first. Unlike traditional banks, we return profits to our members through better rates, lower fees, and enhanced services. While we offer the same financial products—like checking, savings, and loans—our focus remains on empowering our members and supporting their financial well-being. With local decision-making and a commitment to exceptional service, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

At SCCU, we also prioritize our team members by fostering a supportive and collaborative environment that encourages career growth and development. As we continue to grow, we are seeking talented, member-focused professionals to join our team and help deliver innovative financial solutions and outstanding service.

Upon acceptance of an offer with SCCU, I understand that I will be required to complete background screening, employment and education verifications, and drug screening. If I am a member of Space Coast Credit Union, my SCCU membership accounts will be reviewed as part of the employment screening process to determine whether they are in good standing, as defined by SCCU policy. Failure to meet these standards may affect employment eligibility, including the possible withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. I further understand that any misstatements or omissions in this application or during the pre-employment process may be considered falsification and could result in a decision not to hire me, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

I UNDERSTAND that the information requested regarding date of birth, race, and sex is for the sole purpose of gathering the above information accurately and will not be used to discriminate against me in violation of any law. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and complete the required employment eligibility verification documentation upon hire.

If hired, I further understand that my employment is for no definite period and may be terminated at any time without prior notice.

descriptionHtml:
SRC is hiring a hands-on, Agile-embedded Security Engineer responsible for securing virtualized Modeling & Simulation (M&S) environments, automating compliance-as-code across a diverse infrastructure, and developing custom security tools and telemetry dashboards. This role bridges the gap between technical execution and security governance by advising security leadership, managing vulnerabilities, and ensuring continuous compliance with DoD directives.

Vulnerability & Patch Management

  • Implementing, coordinating, and maintaining patching procedures across diverse environments, including Linux, Windows, VMware virtual layers, and Cisco network systems
  • Designing and deploying automated patching processes for Windows and Linux workloads to minimize manual intervention and reduce the overall attack surface
  • Executing and reviewing regular vulnerability scans and DISA STIG compliance audits to assess system risk
  • Analyzing vulnerability data to prioritize and execute remediation efforts across endpoints, networks, and software applications
  • Being responsible for securing and hardening physical and virtual hardware, operating systems, and software configurations

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

  • Supporting the tracking, resolution, and milestone completion for the program’s Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) items
  • Authoring, updating, and maintaining comprehensive program security policies, operational procedures, and technical security standards
  • Ensuring all engineering and operational activities comply with relevant DoD standards, directives, regulations, and NIST frameworks
  • Conducting structured risk assessments and providing direct technical support for program audit activities
  • Serving as a key technical advisor to the ISSO (Information System Security Officer) and ISSM (Information System Security Manager) on the security, engineering, and monitoring of classified DoD networks
  • Creating, updating, and maintaining detailed data flow and system boundary diagrams to support authorization packages
  • Remaining continuously abreast of emerging technologies, cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and modern security tools

Security Architecture & Engineering

  • Designing, implementing, configuring, and managing comprehensive security solutions, including SIEM (Splunk), EDR (Trellix), Host/Network IDS/IPS (Wazuh), firewalls, Identity & Access Management (IAM), and VPNs
  • Evaluating, testing, and integrating new security technologies, tools, and SaaS/on-prem solutions into the existing environment
  • Embedding directly within Agile software development squads, collaborating during sprint planning, story estimation, and retrospectives to ensure security engineering tasks keep pace with release cadence

Requirements

  • Active DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline credential (such as CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, or equivalent) required on day one
  • Active DoD Secret clearance with verified TS/SCI Eligibility (ability to pass a Single Scope Background Investigation)
  • Bachelor’s (BS) degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (equivalent professional experience will be considered)
  • Strong understanding of network protocols, security architecture patterns, and hands-on experience securing both Linux-based and Windows-based systems
  • Highly proficient in scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) to build custom automated tools and utilities
  • Hands-on experience with modern automation and configuration management tools (such as Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, or Chef)
  • Practical understanding of CI/CD concepts, including how to embed security controls, automated testing, and compliance-as-code into deployment pipelines
  • In-depth knowledge of modern threat landscapes, software vulnerabilities, threat mitigation techniques, and standard security processes
  • Strong familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and control sets, specifically NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, SOC 2, and/or ISO 27001
  • Proven ability to author clear, concise, and accurate cybersecurity guidance, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and program documentation

Desired Skills

  • Prior experience supporting cybersecurity operations for high-fidelity DoD modeling, simulation, and synthetic training networks
  • Experience conducting threat modeling, static code analysis (SAST), or dynamic code analysis (DAST) within software development lifecycles
  • Familiarity with securing containerized environments (Docker) and container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes)

Clearance Information

SRC IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT, THIS POSITION WILL REQUIRE U.S. CITIZENSHIP AS WELL AS, A U.S. GOVERNMENT SECURITY CLEARANCE AT THE SECRET LEVEL WITH TOP SECRET / SCI ELGILIBILTY

Minimal (

About Us

Scientific Research Corporation is an advanced information technology and engineering company that provides innovative products and services to government and private industry, as well as independent institutions. At the core of our capabilities is a seasoned team of highly skilled engineers and scientists with multidisciplinary backgrounds. This team is challenged daily to provide cutting edge technology solutions to our clients.

SRC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with a company match, life insurance, vacation and sick paid time off accruals with amounts increasing based on role and years of service, 11 paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, and a work environment that encourages excellence and more. For positions requiring a security clearance, selected applicants will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

descriptionHtml:
Protect what matters most. Join our team to implement and enhance security solutions that safeguard critical systems, data, and infrastructure while driving innovation across the organization.

We’ve been recognized by Newsweek and Plant-A Insights Group as one of America’s Most Admired Workplaces for 2026! As an employee recently said, “I feel I have a lot of support. I feel like part of the team.”

Position Summary:

The primary purpose of the Senior Security Engineer is to harden and protect the Company's Windows and Microsoft 365 infrastructure across all Communities and corporate locations. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on Active Directory and Entra ID security, privileged access, endpoint protection, patch and exposure management, and security monitoring, with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform as the principal toolset, and delivers the technical work in the Company's security plan.

Education/Qualifications:

  • Must have a bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field of science or learning, or must acquire advanced knowledge, which is predominantly intellectual in character and requires the consistent exercise of discretion and judgment, through a demonstrated equivalent combination of prolonged education and progressive work experience pertaining to specialized intellectual instruction for the skills of the position.
  • Seven (7) or more years of progressive experience in systems or security engineering in a Windows enterprise environment, including at least three (3) years in a role with security as the primary responsibility.
  • CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA) is required at hire or must be obtained within six (6) months of hire. One (1) or more of the following is preferred: CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder (CCFR), Microsoft SC-200 or SC-300, GIAC GCAD, SSCP, or similar.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and the ability to travel occasionally to Communities and corporate locations.
  • Hands-on experience hardening Active Directory and Windows Server, including Group Policy, Credential Guard, LSA Protection, Windows LAPS, and NTLM restrictions.
  • Experience implementing privileged access controls, including tiered administration, role-based access, privileged access workstations, and jump hosts.
  • Hands-on experience administering the CrowdStrike Falcon platform in production, including sensor deployment and health, host and prevention policy groups, and detection exclusions. Experience with Falcon Identity Protection, Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, or the Falcon Complete managed service is strongly preferred.
  • Experience securing Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including Conditional Access, multi-factor authentication enforcement, and privileged role management.
  • Experience deploying endpoint security configuration at scale through Intune or Group Policy, including Defender Attack Surface Reduction rules and Tamper Protection.
  • Experience running patch and vulnerability management across a Windows enterprise, including operating system and third-party application patching through Intune, WSUS, or Configuration Manager, vulnerability scanning, and risk-based remediation tracked against defined timelines. Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon Exposure Management is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with a managed detection and response or managed SOC provider on alert triage, escalation, and incident response.
  • Experience with PKI implementation and administration.
  • Previous experience in a healthcare or other HIPAA-regulated environment, and in a multi-site environment, is preferred.
  • Experience with SIEM detection engineering, and with backup immutability and restore testing, is preferred.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead hardening of identity and privileged access. Lock down Active Directory and Windows Server (Credential Guard, LAPS, NTLM restrictions), tighten service accounts, and enforce MFA across VPN and RDP.
  • Own the CrowdStrike Falcon platform end to end. Deploy, tune, and maintain EDR, Identity Protection, and Next-Gen SIEM across all endpoints and servers, including tailored policies for clinical workstations and medication carts.
  • Build detections that catch real threats. Create alerts for lateral movement, credential misuse, and data exfiltration, and act as the technical partner to our managed detection and response provider during triage and incident response.
  • Run patch and exposure management. Drive a staged patching program for operating systems, applications, and firmware, and prioritize vulnerabilities by exploitability and business impact using Falcon Exposure Management.
  • Protect sensitive data and keep recovery reliable. Audit file share and SharePoint permissions, specify egress controls against unauthorized uploads, and help make backups immutable with tested restores.
  • Balance security with resident care. Work with clinical leaders, Community staff, and vendors so controls protect the organization without disrupting care, including onsite visits to Communities.


Advantages:

  • Make a Difference – Be part of a team that strengthens security processes to ensure and support quality resident care.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Health, dental, vision, and retirement plans.
  • Generous PTO – Work-life balance with paid time off and holidays.
  • Team-Oriented Culture – Work with dedicated professionals who value excellence.
  • Stability – Join an organization with a proven track record in skilled nursing care.


Benefits and Perks*:

  • Benefit eligibility the first of the month following 30 days
  • Comprehensive benefit packages including medical, dental, and vision, and more. Health Savings Account available with employer contribution.
  • 401K through Fidelity
  • Employer-paid life insurance (FT employees)
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Educational, leadership, and tuition opportunities
  • Various discount programs offered, including discounted childcare programs through Kindercare
  • Wellness programs offered through WebMD
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Culture of employees creating an IMPACT!
  • Program details can vary amongst buildings. Please see HR for the facility-specific benefit plans.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons shall have the opportunity to be considered for employment without regard to their actual or perceived gender, race, color, national origin, religion, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

descriptionHtml:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

We are bringing a new model to space access: one in which every link in an enormous value chain isn’t limited by those around it. We design rocket engines and propulsion solutions.

Our products and technologies require an extraordinary team—one that will ensure the security of tomorrow’s technologies while deploying today’s best. We are an intrinsically motivated team with a passion for solving problems and empowering each other every day.

About The Role

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Level 3 w/ Clearance) within our Digital Operations team, you won’t just be monitoring alerts or checking compliance boxes. You will be a hands-on technical problem solver and trusted advisor who bridges the gap between commercial enterprise operations and cleared defense program execution—helping our hardware, software, and manufacturing engineers navigate complex security environments without slowing down the pace of innovation.

Reporting up through Digital Operations, you will sit at the intersection of DevOps, Digital Manufacturing, Software Engineering, Zero-Trust Networking, and IT. As Ursa Major scales from 380 to 500+ employees and doubles our cleared cybersecurity bench, you will play a central role in both evolving our CMMC Level 2 posture and maintaining hands-on security engineering across classified spaces, secure labs, and air-gapped networks

Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Enablement & Creative Risk Mitigation
    • Partner directly with non-cyber employees (program managers, propulsion engineers, test stand operators, cleared defense leads) to understand their workflows and help them safely manage CUI and classified data flows without unnecessary friction.
    • Approach security challenges with nuance rather than black-and-white rules. Find pragmatically secure pathways that satisfy federal requirements (RMF, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171) while keeping physical hardware engineering, CAD/CAM development, and classified testing moving forward.
    • Design controls around engineering workflows to eliminate latency and operational bottlenecks, ensuring compliance feels like an accelerator rather than a roadblock.
  • Classified Systems & Hybrid Security Engineering
    • Lead hands-on security engineering, vulnerability management, and continuous monitoring across classified program enclaves, air-gapped networks, and secure testing environments.
    • Execute Risk Management Framework (RMF) and JSIG lifecycle tasks—including system hardening using STIGs/SCAP, vulnerability scanning (ACAS/Tenable), eMASS package management, System Security Plan (SSP) authoring, and POA&M remediation.
    • Manage and optimize technical security controls (EDR, SIEM log aggregation, firewalls, identity platforms) across both enterprise and classified network environments.
  • Leadership & Technical Ownership (Level 3)
    • Act as a subject matter expert who tackles ambiguous, high-complexity security segmentation challenges with minimal supervision, taking full ownership from diagnosis to resolution.
    • Partner with physical security, FSO, and ISSM staff to support secure facility operations, media sanitization, DCSA audit readiness, and classified authorization packages.
    • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior staff and IT team members, translating complex federal regulations into clear, actionable advice for non-cyber stakeholders.
Minimum Qualifications

  • Active DoD Secret clearance required (Top Secret or TS/SCI eligibility highly preferred).
  • 4+ years of dedicated cybersecurity engineering experience in DoD, cleared defense contractor, or high-rigor regulated environments.
  • Current DoD 8570/8140 IAM/IAT Level II or III certification (e.g., Security+, CISSP, CISM, CASP+, or CySA+).
  • Deep familiarity with government regulations, specifically NIST SP 800-171, CMMC Level 2, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, and JSIG requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience executing STIG hardening, SCAP compliance scanning, vulnerability remediation, and EDR/SIEM administration across air-gapped or classified Windows/Linux environments.
  • Proven track record of working constructively with engineering and business stakeholders—focusing on trust-building, communication, and enabling business outcomes rather than simple ticket-taking.

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $128,000 - $160,000, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

Classification: Full-time Exempt

Benefits Include: (Please note, Interns are not eligible for benefits)

  • Unlimited PTO - Vacation, Sick, Personal, and Bereavement
  • Paid Parental and Adoptive Leave
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Tax Advantage Accounts (HSA/FSA)
  • Employer Paid Short and Long Term Disability, Basic Life, AD&D

Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance.

companyDescription: Sirona Medical Inc. is addressing the needs of today’s radiology practices with a novel cloud-native platform that unifies radiology IT applications – worklist, viewer, reporter, and AI – onto a single, streamlined Workspace. Sirona’s radiology operating system (RadOS) puts radiologists in the driver’s seat with AI-powered solutions that simplify their workflow and amplify their work product. Based in San Francisco, CA, Sirona Medical is founded on a deep understanding of both the practice and business of radiology, with the goal of enabling radiologists to work as fast as they can think.
companySlogan: Unify Radiology IT. Simplify Radiologist Workflow. Amplify Radiology Practice.
descriptionHtml:
About Sirona Medical

At Sirona Medical, we’re building software that enables physicians to work as fast as they can think.

Each year in the U.S., billions of patient images are captured—and nearly all of them are reviewed and diagnosed by radiologists. These specialists are the central hub of diagnostic medicine: over 80% of all healthcare data flows through radiology IT systems. Yet despite their pivotal role, radiologists are overburdened by outdated, fragmented software which limits their efficiency and ultimately the quality and efficiency of care that health systems can provide patients. That’s where Sirona comes in.

We’re a San Francisco-based, cloud-native software company with employees around the world. Our deep understanding of both the practice and business of radiology has allowed us to build RadOS—a unified, AI-powered operating system powering the entire radiology workflows.

How Sirona Solves the Problem

Sirona Is Uniquely Positioned To Transform The Way Radiology Is Practiced. We're Delivering The Organizational Shift That Both Individual Radiologists And Entire Practices Urgently Need

  • A unified, intuitive, and platform-agnostic solution
  • A streamlined workspace that makes every part of the radiologist’s workflow faster and easier
  • The freedom to read from anywhere, for anyone

By cutting clicks, optimizing diagnostic time, and unlocking efficiencies that extend far beyond the reading room into all care settings, Sirona empowers radiologists—and in doing so, we help the entire healthcare system move faster, smarter, and with greater impact on patient outcomes.

For more information, please visit https://sironamedical.com/join/.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior/Staff Security Engineer to help protect the infrastructure, applications, and patient data that power RadOS. You'll work closely with Engineering, IT, and Compliance to design and implement security controls across our cloud environment, support our HIPAA/SOC 2 compliance posture, and build the tooling and processes that let us move fast without compromising the trust our customers place in us. This role reports to the Vice President of Regulatory affairs and Quality Management. and will be a hands-on, individual-contributor role with significant autonomy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls across our cloud infrastructure (AWS) supporting a HIPAA-regulated, SOC 2 audited environment
  • Lead and/or support threat modeling, security design reviews, and secure code review for new features and architecture
  • Own vulnerability management: identify, triage, and drive remediation of vulnerabilities across cloud and application layers
  • Build and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting (SIEM) to support detection and incident response
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks; participate in and lead incident response when needed
  • Partner with Engineering to embed security into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar)
  • Manage identity and access controls, including least-privilege IAM, SSO/MFA enforcement, and access reviews
  • Support compliance initiatives and audits (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, HIPAA risk assessments) and own evidence collection and control documentation for your areas
  • Evaluate and implement security tooling (CSPM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability scanning) as the environment scales
  • Mentor engineers on secure development practices and act as a security point of contact for product and engineering teams

Key Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in security engineering, infrastructure security, or a closely related role
  • Hands-on experience securing cloud environments (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP a plus)
  • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27000 series or similar in a regulated environment
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar) and scripting/automation (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Experience with vulnerability management, SIEM/logging platforms, and incident response
  • Working knowledge of identity and access management, Zero Trust principles, and secure network architecture
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain risk and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Prior experience in healthcare, health IT, or another highly regulated industry is a plus
  • Computer Science or similar degree is a plus
  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, or similar) are a plus but not required

Benefits

  • Stock Options
  • Flexible PTO
  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • 401K matching
  • Apple equipment
  • Sponsorship for conferences, continuing education, etc
  • Dynamic engineering role–technological innovation is at the core of our business
  • Growth and learning opportunities from a startup environment include working closely with an international team of scientists, engineers, platform architects, programmers and professionals
  • Do something morally benevolent!

The annual US base salary range for this full-time position is $145,000 - $185,000 + equity + benefits. Pay scale is flexible depending on experience. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, competencies, experience, relevant education and training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
