descriptionHtml:
Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

Business Title(s): Sr. Security Engineer

Employment Type: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: In-office- Any employee, in any Clearbrook office, can apply for this opportunity and stay in their current location.

Summary

The Sr. Security Engineer is a senior technical member of the Cyber Security Engineering team responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving enterprise security technologies and controls.

This role requires a hands-on security engineer with broad experience across endpoint, network, cloud, application, identity, and data security. The engineer will serve as a technical authority for assigned security platforms, help define engineering standards and architecture, lead complex implementations and migrations, troubleshoot escalated security issues, and work closely with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Application, and other technology teams.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge with strong troubleshooting and automation skills and can take ownership of security capabilities from architecture and implementation through operational support and continuous improvement.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Design, engineer, implement, configure, and maintain enterprise security technologies across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Engineer and maintain Web Application Firewall (WAF) capabilities to protect internet-facing applications and APIs against application-layer threats.
  • Support Managed Extended Detection and Response (MxDR/XDR) capabilities, including endpoint telemetry, detection coverage, investigation support, containment, and integration with the broader security ecosystem.
  • Engineer and support endpoint detection and response (EDR) controls across workstation and server environments.
  • Maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) and endpoint security capabilities, including device configuration, security baselines, encryption, compliance, and protection policies.
  • Engineer Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and secure web access capabilities supporting workforce connectivity to private and internet-based applications.
  • Support identity and access security, including strong authentication, conditional access, privileged access controls, identity threat protection, and access policy enforcement.
  • Develop and maintain cloud security controls across infrastructure, platforms, workloads, and SaaS environments.
  • Support vulnerability management, including vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation coordination, security hardening, and validation of remediation.
  • Implement and maintain data security and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls designed to identify, classify, monitor, and protect sensitive information.
  • Engineer email, collaboration, and messaging security controls protecting users from phishing, malicious content, impersonation, and other communication-based threats.
  • Support Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and security monitoring integrations by ensuring security platforms generate appropriate telemetry for detection, investigation, audit, and response.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between security platforms to improve telemetry sharing, detection, response, and operational efficiency.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and serve as an escalation point for complex security technology issues.
  • Evaluate emerging security technologies and capabilities through technical research, proof-of-concept testing, and security architecture reviews.
  • Partner with infrastructure, network, cloud, application, identity, operations, and engineering teams to embed security into technology designs and implementations.
  • Develop automation to improve provisioning, configuration management, evidence collection, monitoring, incident response, and other repeatable security engineering activities.
  • Establish and maintain security configuration standards and hardening baselines using recognized industry frameworks and vendor-recommended security guidance.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and decommission/runbook documentation to ensure security capabilities are scalable and supportable.
  • Participate in incident response activities by providing engineering expertise, technical analysis, containment support, and remediation guidance.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes, consolidate security capabilities, improve control effectiveness, and strengthen the overall security architecture.

Qualifications / Experience Required

  • A minimum of 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, infrastructure security, or a closely related discipline.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity or computer science is strongly preferred
  • Strong hands-on experience implementing and supporting multiple enterprise security technologies.
  • Deep understanding of endpoint, network, application, identity, cloud, and data security principles.
  • Experience with WAF, EDR/XDR or MxDR, MDM, ZTNA, vulnerability management, SIEM, DLP, identity security, and cloud security concepts.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux security and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, firewalls, routing, and network segmentation.
  • Experience securing cloud and SaaS environments.
  • Experience with security hardening and configuration standards using frameworks such as CIS Controls/CIS Benchmarks and NIST guidance.
  • Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Python, APIs, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze complex security and infrastructure problems across multiple technology layers.
  • Ability to assess technical risk and translate security requirements into practical engineering solutions.
  • Ability to independently manage engineering initiatives from requirements and design through implementation, documentation, and operational transition.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, security leadership, business stakeholders, and third-party service providers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a regulated enterprise environment such as insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another industry with significant security and compliance requirements.
  • Experience leading enterprise security platform migrations, implementations, or modernization efforts.
  • Experience integrating security technologies using APIs, scripting, event streams, or other automation methods.
  • Experience supporting security investigations and incident response.
  • Understanding of modern application and API security architectures.
  • Experience with hybrid environments spanning traditional data centers, cloud infrastructure, SaaS platforms, and remote users.
  • Relevant industry certifications in security, cloud, networking, or security engineering.

Core Competencies

Security Engineering | Enterprise Security Architecture | Application Security | WAF | Endpoint Security | EDR/XDR/MxDR | MDM | Zero Trust | Identity Security | Cloud Security | Vulnerability Management | Data Protection & DLP | SIEM & Security Monitoring | Security Automation | Infrastructure Hardening | Incident Response | Technical Troubleshooting | Security Architecture | Risk Management

The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.

  • Richmond and Albany Pay Range: $116,382 - $138,414
  • Chicago Pay Range: $128,010 - $152,184
  • New York City Pay Range: $139,638 - $166,260

Please Note

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.

If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.

Benefits And Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we aspire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.

Be successful in this role

    • Evaluates technical designs and recommends controls based on company policies, technical standards, regulatory obligations, risk, and business objectives.
    • Develops security baselines, technical standards, implementation guidance, and secure configuration requirements.

  • Cloud Security
    • Provides senior technical expertise for the design, implementation, and assessment of security controls supporting Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, software-as-a-service platforms, and other approved cloud services.
    • Assesses cloud resources, storage, networking, applications, identities, integrations, and service configurations for security risk.
    • Develops and maintains cloud security baselines and configuration standards.
    • Identifies cloud security exposures and partners with technology owners to develop practical remediation or risk-reduction plans.
    • Reviews encryption, public access, logging, privileged access, network connectivity, and data protection requirements for cloud services.
    • Provides technical guidance for cloud security posture management and continuous improvement activities.
  • Identity Security
    • Partners with the Identity and Access Management team to support secure authentication, authorization, privileged access, and identity governance initiatives.
    • Applies an understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, multifactor authentication, Conditional Access policy concepts, risk-based access controls, privileged access, and Zero Trust principles when assessing security designs and incidents.
    • Assesses security risks associated with user accounts, service accounts, application identities, machine identities, credentials, and third-party access.

    • Provides senior technical expertise for escalated alerts, investigations, threat analysis, and response activities requiring internal security engineering support.
    • Develops and improves detection capabilities, alerting logic, dashboards, queries, reporting, and monitoring coverage.
    • Provides technical guidance for improving monitoring effectiveness, detection coverage, escalation quality, and security visibility.
    • Identifies gaps in logging, telemetry, data quality, and visibility and coordinates improvements with appropriate technology teams.
    • Assesses emerging threats and recommends updates to monitoring, detection, and defensive controls.
  • Incident Response
    • Provides senior technical expertise for escalated security events, investigations, and incident response activities.
    • Leads, supports, or provides technical expertise for investigation, containment, remediation, recovery, and post-incident review activities associated with significant security incidents.

    • Coordinates response activities with managed security service providers, technology teams, leadership, legal and privacy partners, cyber insurance providers, and third-party responders as appropriate.
    • Documents technical findings, contributing factors, corrective actions, and recommended improvements.
    • Develops and maintains incident response procedures, technical playbooks, and investigation methods.

    • Provides technical expertise and recommendations to system owners regarding remediation plans, compensating controls, and risk-reduction strategies.
    • Validates remediation activities and provides technical input for exception or risk acceptance decisions.
    • Supports vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, attack-surface reviews, control validation, and security assessments.
    • Develops reporting that communicates material exposures, remediation progress, aging, and recurring control weaknesses.

    • Partners with application development, infrastructure, and architecture teams to integrate security into the system development lifecycle.
    • Reviews application architecture, authentication, authorization, data handling, interfaces, application programming interfaces, and third-party components.
    • Supports secure code analysis, dependency review, secrets detection, application testing, and remediation processes.
    • Identifies opportunities to automate security checks within development and deployment workflows.
    • Provides practical technical guidance for application and software supply-chain risks.

    • Provides technical expertise for the design, implementation, and assessment of controls related to data classification, encryption, retention, information protection, and data loss prevention.
    • Evaluates how regulated, confidential, and sensitive information is collected, stored, processed, transmitted, shared, and disposed of.

    • Assesses security controls for information subject to HIPAA and other applicable legal, contractual, and regulatory obligations.
    • Supports investigations involving potential unauthorized disclosure or exposure of sensitive information.

    • Provides technical expertise in developing and maintaining scripts, integrations, workflows, queries, and automation that improve security monitoring, investigation, reporting, and remediation.
    • Uses appropriate scripting, query, application programming interface, source control, and orchestration technologies to improve operational efficiency.
    • Automates repeatable security processes where practical while maintaining appropriate testing, documentation, approval, and change controls.
    • Supports the integration of security checks into infrastructure-as-code and deployment processes when appropriate.
  • Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance
    • Analyzes changes in the threat, technology, regulatory, and compliance environments and evaluates their effect on organizational risk.
    • Contributes technical expertise to the development and maintenance of information security policies, standards, procedures, baselines, and guidelines.
    • Provides technical evidence and support for audits, regulatory examinations, security assessments, and control reviews.
    • Performs security risk and control assessments and recommends practical risk-treatment options.
    • Provides technical expertise supporting third-party technology, vendor security, and architecture reviews.

descriptionHtml:
At Esper, we’re on a mission to empower dynamic and responsive policymaking in government. We’re building the platform that connects existing data, stakeholders, and public policy goals into a single dynamic system, transforming bureaucracy into infrastructure that encourages innovation and collaboration.

As a fast-growing GovTech company, Esper is at the intersection of two powerful forces: the modernization of government operations and the transformative potential of data-driven decision-making. Our customer base is expanding rapidly, and we’re building the team that will define how public policy is shaped for decades to come.

What You'll Do

Esper is looking for a Security Engineer to own the security of our platform. Because Esper's customers include state, local, and federal government agencies, the security and compliance posture of our platform is central to the business. This is a hybrid role based in Austin, TX (three days a week in office), reporting to engineering leadership.

As our first dedicated security hire, you'll make a direct impact through:

  • Running our vulnerability management program: triaging findings from scanners, dependency checks, and customer reports, prioritizing by real risk, and driving fixes to closure
  • Planning and coordinating our annual penetration tests with outside firms, and owning remediation and retesting
  • Securing our AWS environment, including IAM, logging, encryption, network controls, and security monitoring, implemented through Terraform pull requests
  • Building security into how we ship: secure code review, dependency and secrets scanning, and security checks in CI/CD
  • Supporting our annual SOC 2 Type II audit and our first ISO 27001 certification, with a focus on technical controls and evidence
  • Answering technical questions in customer security reviews and questionnaires
  • Responding to security incidents and improving how we detect and handle them


Skills And Experience

  • 3-5 years in security engineering, cloud security, or a DevOps or infrastructure role with significant security responsibility
  • Hands-on AWS experience, especially IAM, CloudTrail, KMS, VPC networking, and security services such as GuardDuty and Security Hub
  • Working Terraform skills: you can read a module, make a change, and open a clean pull request
  • Experience running a vulnerability management process and prioritizing findings by real-world risk
  • Familiarity with common web application vulnerabilities, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to fix them
  • Experience implementing technical controls for SOC 2 or ISO 27001, including supporting an audit
  • Strong communication skills — you will be working closely with all of engineering, as well as auditors and customer security teams
  • Ability to write clear, detailed security documentation


Bonus Points

  • Experience with FedRAMP
  • A security certification such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty or CISSP (we'll sponsor one if you don't have it yet)
  • Hands-on penetration testing or bug bounty experience
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps pipelines
  • Experience at a govtech or other compliance-driven organization
  • Experience with Drata, Vanta, or a similar compliance automation platform
  • Scripting in Python or Bash to automate security checks
  • Comfort using AI assistants in your daily work, with a habit of checking their output


Perks And Benefits

The base salary range for this role is 130,000-150,000, plus equity. Final offers depend on experience and skills.

  • Being a part of an innovative and collaborative team that will both support and challenge you
  • Significant opportunity for growth and ownership
  • Ability to shape Esper for the long-term
  • Paid certification exam and prep costs, plus an annual training budget
  • Paid holidays & unlimited PTO
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous parental & sick leave
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer match
  • Short/Long term disability & life insurance
  • Flexible spending account (FSA)
  • Work anniversary equity grants
  • Quarterly bonuses
  • Monthly stipend to offset remote work expenses
  • Office equipment allowance
  • Paid Time Off to participate in volunteer/community events

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Job Description:

AssetMark is a leading strategic provider of innovative investment and consulting solutions serving independent financial advisors. We provide investment, relationship, and practice management solutions that advisors use in helping clients achieve wealth, independence, and purpose.

The Job/What You'll Do:

The Security Engineer II is responsible for ensuring high security across our organization and our product and service lines. This is a great opportunity to build your career with a growing company. The Security Engineer will have the opportunity to work with various teams to help analyze technical requirements, define configuration specifications, and develop project plans. An ideal Security Engineer candidate is someone who has background knowledge in cybersecurity with a passion for problem-solving.

We can only consider candidates for this position who are able to accommodate a hybrid work schedule and are close to one of our following offices: Atlanta, GA, or Charlotte, NC.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in designing, enhancing, testing, and implementing security technologies used throughout the organization.
  • Provide technical support of information security technologies, providing problem analysis and resolution in a timely manner.
  • Investigate and quickly resolve security incidents and recommend corrective actions related to incidents.
  • Implement, configure, and maintain IAM Infrastructure including Active Directory, EntraID and MFA.
  • Perform scheduled and on demand vulnerability assessments and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Perform threat modeling on key products and services by identifying threats and developing controls to prevent, detect, and respond.
  • Partner with engineering teams to integrate and automate security at every level of the software development lifecycle.
  • Provide security recommendations and solutions for infrastructure and applications in cloud environment.
  • Perform special projects as assigned, while effectively managing time with competing priorities.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Working knowledge and technical understanding of cloud service platforms (AWS, Azure, etc.)
  • General knowledge of networking, cybersecurity frameworks, constructs, and auditable standards.
  • Basic knowledge and experience with scripting and programming (PowerShell, bash, python, IaC, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience working with SIEM, CSPM, and EDR tools.
  • Strong communication and collaborative skills


Education & Experience:

  • 3-7 years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, or information technology
  • BS degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or equivalent degree
  • Experience working with JIRA Project Management
  • Experience working with IAM solutions (Active Directory, EntraID, Okta, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience of CrowdStrike Falcon, Check Point Harmony, and Microsoft Defender
  • Experience building and securing Infrastructure as Code (IaC)


Compensation: The Base Salary range for this position is between $85,000-$100,000.

This information reflects a base salary range that AssetMark reasonably expects to pay for the position based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, education, experience, and actual work location. This position will also be eligible for additional variable incentive compensation and competitive benefits.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US to be considered. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Who We Are & What We Offer:

We are AssetMark, a company on the move, shaping the future of financial services. Growth is in our DNA. Every day, we combine technology, insight, and collaboration to create new possibilities for advisors, for our people and for our investors. At AssetMark your ideas matter; they’re heard, valued, and drive meaningful change. Join a team that sets new standards and creates space for you to thrive and do your best work.

Our Mission

Our mission is simple: to help our 10,500+ financial advisors make a meaningful difference in their clients’ lives. We do this by combining powerful technology, holistic support, and expert consulting to help advisors run stronger, more efficient businesses. Backed by a comprehensive suite of investment solutions and a trust company that boasts of $150B+ AUM, our platform empowers advisors to deliver exceptional service and an outstanding client experience.

Our Values

Heart. Client Success. Integrity. Respect. Excellence. Our values are how we show up every day.

We believe in:

  • Leading with Heart, in truly making a difference in the lives of others: teammates, clients, investors and communities.
  • Obsessing over Client Success, bringing a relentless focus on what matters to clients that sets us apart and creates loyal, lasting relationships.
  • Unyielding Integrity, doing what’s right, always. Even when it’s hard.
  • Collective Respect, in being authentic, inclusive and valuing all voices while winning together.
  • Operating with Excellence, in learning fast, continuously improving, innovating and collaborating to find new and better solutions.


These values shape our culture, guide our decisions, and define what it means to be part of the AssetMark family.

Our Culture & Benefits

Our culture brings our mission and values to life. Here, we do what’s right, embrace diverse ideas, and innovate together. We also offer a wide range of benefits to support you and your family—because thriving at work starts with thriving in life.

  • Flex Time or Paid Time Off and Sick Time Off
  • 401K – 6% Employer Match
  • Medical, Dental, Vision – HDHP or PPO
  • HSA – Employer contribution (HDHP only)
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Career Development / Recognition
  • Fitness Reimbursement
  • Hybrid Work Schedule


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, AssetMark is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued.

descriptionHtml:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. We offer more than 2 million products and have over 80 years of experience across dozens of industries. We aim to execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise for all our stakeholders, including our associates.

Requisition ID : 21835

Employment Type : Full Time

Job Category : Digital/IT

Work Location : Davidson, NC

Brief Position Summary

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer is a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving enterprise cybersecurity controls across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, application, email, and data-protection environments.

This hands-on role engineers and integrates security platforms, translates security architecture and risk requirements into reliable technical solutions, and partners with Infrastructure, Security Architecture, GRC, DevSecOps, IAM, Application Development, Audit, Compliance, and business stakeholders to reduce cyber risk and improve operational resilience.

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer serves as a technical escalation point for complex security issues, drives incident response and threat-informed control improvements, develops automation and repeatable engineering practices, and maintains the documentation and evidence necessary for effective operations and audit readiness.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, configure, integrate, and support enterprise cybersecurity technologies across endpoint security, network security, cloud security, identity security, email security, vulnerability management, data protection, logging, monitoring, and security automation.
  • Translate security architecture, policies, standards, risk findings, regulatory obligations, and business requirements into practical technical designs, implementation plans, and operational controls.
  • Engineer and maintain integrations among security platforms, infrastructure services, cloud environments, identity providers, enterprise applications, ticketing systems, and monitoring platforms using supported APIs, connectors, and automation.
  • Lead technical implementation activities for cybersecurity projects, including requirements definition, design review, configuration, testing, deployment, validation, documentation, operational transition, and post-implementation improvement.
  • Assess the security of network, endpoint, cloud, application, identity, and data flows; identify control gaps and design risk-based remediation or compensating controls.
  • Configure and validate security controls supporting least privilege, segmentation, secure access, threat prevention, detection, logging, vulnerability reduction, secure configuration, and data protection.
  • Improve prevention, telemetry, detection coverage, investigation workflows, containment capabilities, and response automation based on incidents, threat intelligence, attack techniques, and control testing.
  • Provide senior-level troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex security platform failures, integration issues, control gaps, access problems, performance concerns, and cybersecurity incidents.
  • Leads the technical response for escalated cybersecurity incidents
  • Develop scripts, queries, dashboards, workflows, and automation to reduce manual work, improve control reliability, accelerate investigation and remediation, and provide measurable operational outcomes.
  • Perform technical security assessments, design reviews, configuration reviews, control validation, and risk analysis for new and existing technology solutions.
  • Support vulnerability management by validating exposure, prioritizing remediation, partnering with technology owners, evaluating exceptions, and confirming corrective actions.
  • Maintain security platform health, lifecycle plans, upgrade paths, licensing awareness, capacity requirements, vendor relationships, and service-level performance.
  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical standards, implementation procedures, operational runbooks, support guides, control evidence, knowledge articles, and recovery procedures.
  • Collect technical evidence and support internal audit, external audit, customer, regulatory, and compliance activities involving cybersecurity controls.
  • Mentor administrators and analysts, lead technical knowledge transfer, promote consistent engineering, documentation, testing, and change-management practices.
  • Participate in an on-call or after-hours escalation rotation as needed to support security incidents, critical vulnerabilities, maintenance, or service restoration.
  • Foster the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participate in special projects and perform additional duties as required.

Qualifications

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of seven years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in one or more functional security domains; or a minimum of two years in a dedicated cybersecurity function combined with six or more years of hands-on infrastructure experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, implementing, integrating, and supporting enterprise cybersecurity technologies in complex hybrid enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience in at least three of the following domains: endpoint security; network security; cloud security; identity and access management; email security; vulnerability management; SIEM and security analytics; data protection; application or API security; security automation.
  • Experience performing technical security assessments, design reviews, control validation, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience supporting security incidents, threat investigations, containment, recovery, or post-incident control improvements.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, APIs, or query languages such as PowerShell, Python, REST, JSON, KQL, SQL, or equivalent technologies.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise authentication, authorization, encryption, certificate, logging, network, cloud, and secure configuration concepts.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance obligations such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOX, PCI DSS, CMMC, or related requirements.
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, implementation plans, operational runbooks, and audit evidence.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple complex initiatives, work effectively under pressure, and critically challenge proposed designs or processes when warranted.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft security and identity platforms, CrowdStrike, Sumo Logic, Cato Networks, Wiz, CyberArk, Saviynt, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise technologies.
  • Experience securing Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, GCP, SaaS, containers, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, or hybrid enterprise environments.
  • Experience using threat modeling, adversary techniques, attack-path analysis, purple teaming, control testing, or detection engineering to improve security design and coverage.
  • Experience in a regulated industry or an environment subject to formal security, privacy, contractual, or audit obligations.
  • One or more relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCED, OSCP, Security+, Microsoft security certifications, cloud security certifications, or equivalent technical credentials.
  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Other Requirements

  • Position requires up to 5% of travel
  • This position will require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information ( ITAR ) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information ( CUI )

Job Category : Digital/IT

Brief Position Summary

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer is a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving enterprise cybersecurity controls across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, application, email, and data-protection environments.

This hands-on role engineers and integrates security platforms, translates security architecture and risk requirements into reliable technical solutions, and partners with Infrastructure, Security Architecture, GRC, DevSecOps, IAM, Application Development, Audit, Compliance, and business stakeholders to reduce cyber risk and improve operational resilience.

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer serves as a technical escalation point for complex security issues, drives incident response and threat-informed control improvements, develops automation and repeatable engineering practices, and maintains the documentation and evidence necessary for effective operations and audit readiness.

Duties And Responsibilities



- Design, implement, configure, integrate, and support enterprise cybersecurity technologies across endpoint security, network security, cloud security, identity security, email security, vulnerability management, data protection, logging, monitoring, and security automation.
- Translate security architecture, policies, standards, risk findings, regulatory obligations, and business requirements into practical technical designs, implementation plans, and operational controls.
- Engineer and maintain integrations among security platforms, infrastructure services, cloud environments, identity providers, enterprise applications, ticketing systems, and monitoring platforms using supported APIs, connectors, and automation.
- Lead technical implementation activities for cybersecurity projects, including requirements definition, design review, configuration, testing, deployment, validation, documentation, operational transition, and post-implementation improvement.
- Assess the security of network, endpoint, cloud, application, identity, and data flows; identify control gaps and design risk-based remediation or compensating controls.
- Configure and validate security controls supporting least privilege, segmentation, secure access, threat prevention, detection, logging, vulnerability reduction, secure configuration, and data protection.
- Improve prevention, telemetry, detection coverage, investigation workflows, containment capabilities, and response automation based on incidents, threat intelligence, attack techniques, and control testing.
- Provide senior-level troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex security platform failures, integration issues, control gaps, access problems, performance concerns, and cybersecurity incidents.
- Leads the technical response for escalated cybersecurity incidents
- Develop scripts, queries, dashboards, workflows, and automation to reduce manual work, improve control reliability, accelerate investigation and remediation, and provide measurable operational outcomes.
- Perform technical security assessments, design reviews, configuration reviews, control validation, and risk analysis for new and existing technology solutions.
- Support vulnerability management by validating exposure, prioritizing remediation, partnering with technology owners, evaluating exceptions, and confirming corrective actions.
- Maintain security platform health, lifecycle plans, upgrade paths, licensing awareness, capacity requirements, vendor relationships, and service-level performance.
- Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical standards, implementation procedures, operational runbooks, support guides, control evidence, knowledge articles, and recovery procedures.
- Collect technical evidence and support internal audit, external audit, customer, regulatory, and compliance activities involving cybersecurity controls.
- Mentor administrators and analysts, lead technical knowledge transfer, promote consistent engineering, documentation, testing, and change-management practices.
- Participate in an on-call or after-hours escalation rotation as needed to support security incidents, critical vulnerabilities, maintenance, or service restoration.
- Foster the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
- Participate in special projects and perform additional duties as required.

Qualifications

What You Need:



- Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
- Minimum of seven years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in one or more functional security domains; or a minimum of two years in a dedicated cybersecurity function combined with six or more years of hands-on infrastructure experience.
- Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, implementing, integrating, and supporting enterprise cybersecurity technologies in complex hybrid enterprise environments.
- Strong experience in at least three of the following domains: endpoint security; network security; cloud security; identity and access management; email security; vulnerability management; SIEM and security analytics; data protection; application or API security; security automation.
- Experience performing technical security assessments, design reviews, control validation, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
- Experience supporting security incidents, threat investigations, containment, recovery, or post-incident control improvements.
- Experience with scripting, automation, APIs, or query languages such as PowerShell, Python, REST, JSON, KQL, SQL, or equivalent technologies.
- Working knowledge of enterprise authentication, authorization, encryption, certificate, logging, network, cloud, and secure configuration concepts.
- Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance obligations such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOX, PCI DSS, CMMC, or related requirements.
- Ability to create clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, implementation plans, operational runbooks, and audit evidence.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
- Ability to independently manage multiple complex initiatives, work effectively under pressure, and critically challenge proposed designs or processes when warranted.

Bonus Points If You Have



- Hands-on experience with Microsoft security and identity platforms, CrowdStrike, Sumo Logic, Cato Networks, Wiz, CyberArk, Saviynt, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise technologies.
- Experience securing Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, GCP, SaaS, containers, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, or hybrid enterprise environments.
- Experience using threat modeling, adversary techniques, attack-path analysis, purple teaming, control testing, or detection engineering to improve security design and coverage.
- Experience in a regulated industry or an environment subject to formal security, privacy, contractual, or audit obligations.
- One or more relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCED, OSCP, Security+, Microsoft security certifications, cloud security certifications, or equivalent technical credentials.
- Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Other Requirements



- Position requires up to 5% of travel
- This position will require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information ( ITAR ) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information ( CUI )

Job Description

Why GM Financial Cybersecurity?

Innovation isn’t just a talking point at GM Financial, it’s how we operate. By joining our team, you’ll work in a mission-focused environment with specialized teams, including Engineering, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, Incident Response, Firewall, Governance, Risk, Architecture and Offensive Security. These teams collaborate to identify, manage and respond to threats, all while driving innovation across the environment.

Cybersecurity is central to our strategic vision, so you’ll benefit from exceptional leadership visibility, with direct reporting lines to the CEO. This structure ensures your work is recognized and supported at the highest levels, while also enabling bold innovation and the adoption of cutting-edge technologies.

Shape the future of Cybersecurity at GM Financial, with the freedom to explore, the tools to build and the support to thrive.

Responsibilities

About the role

﻿The Sr Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for developing, deploying, monitoring, tuning, evaluating, reporting and maintaining systems and procedures to identify and mitigate threats to the corporate network, corporate assets and corporate users. This team member will identify core requirements, design and implement security technologies, and work with stakeholders to perform ongoing tuning and alerting on those technologies. Said technologies may include, but are not limited to: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Security Incident Event Management (SIEM), User Behavior Analytics, Host Intrusion Prevention (HIPS) and Web/Email Gateway. This team member will be responsible for both technical implementation of systems and communication of security requirements to management and security leadership.

In This Role You Will

  • ﻿Engineer, design, install and support security technologies such as Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Host Intrusion Prevention (HIPS), Security Incident and Event Managers (SIEM), Endpoint Security, Vulnerability Management (VM), Email Gateways, Breach Mitigation, Certificate Management, SSL encryption and decryption, Identity Management, Cloud Security, Database Security, Web Gateways
  • Proactively identifies potential technologies to better secure enterprise information assets
  • Using information from threat intelligence feeds, incident response and SIEM analysis, identifies and deploys custom rules and policies to security technologies to further protect information assets
  • Works with cybersecurity management to develop and implement project plans to rapidly mature security initiatives
  • Participation in emergency response team activities for responding to various security incidents
  • Prepare and update information procedures, standards and/or other technical requirement documents
  • Participate in periodic information systems risk assessments
  • Develop detailed proposals and plans for new information security systems that would enhance or enable new capabilities for network or host systems
  • Recommends and evaluates security tools to identify more efficient and effective security measures

Qualifications

What makes you an ideal candidate?

  • Local and wide area networking concepts, principles and protocols
  • Advanced knowledge in Infrastructure design and management
  • Working knowledge of management processes such as personnel administration, planning and budgeting
  • Strong technical skills and hands on experience in information security as it relates to server security, client security, user security, network communications and data storage
  • Practical experience implementing security solutions, specifically Data Loss Prevention and performing initial tuning and scanning for confidential data in the environment
  • Proven expertise developing custom rule sets for Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools to identify specific data types based on feedback and requirements from business stakeholders including Compliance and Legal Counsel
  • Practical experience scaling DLP solutions to meet enterprise data sizes and performing tuning to manage the amount of alerting that occurs
  • Strong knowledge of IT technologies and methods to secure them, specifically for databases, SharePoint, storage area networking, cloud-based storage, and data warehouses
  • Strong working knowledge of Intel platforms, iSeries and pSeries servers
  • Advanced understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) best practices and processes
  • Experience with UML Design Tools
  • Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP, OSI model and imp subnetting
  • High level understanding of technology infrastructure, security concepts and platforms
  • Demonstrated success in project management
  • Advanced knowledge of IBM pSeries hardware, operating systems and TSM backup infrastructure
  • Advanced knowledge of the OSI model and security that is associated with each layer
  • Understanding of routing and switching protocols as they relate to load balancing
  • Strong understanding of application layer protocols including HTTP, SSH, SSL and DNS
  • Knowledge and stay abreast on the latest security and privacy legislation, regulations, advisories, alerts and vulnerabilities
  • Knowledge of IT security processes and controls as well as IT infrastructure and networking technical knowledge
  • Possess strong understanding of cloud technologies and concepts
  • Experience securing cloud deployments on common platforms like Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform (no minimum of two years)
  • Experience with deploying environments by defining infrastructure as code (IaC)
  • Experience with declarative IaC approaches and immutable infrastructure is a plus
  • Experience with securing container deployments, Kubernetes, managed Kubernetes PaaS services, Agile environments, and DevOps environments
  • Experience with managing infrastructure through CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of Linux operating systems and microservice architecture
  • Background in scripting and automation in widely used languages such as Python, Go, Ruby, etc.
  • Familiarity with Terraform is a plusAbility to think strategically and make collaborative decisions
  • Ability to apply structured analysis methods to various types of data to establish trends, determine variability and business impact
  • Communicates quickly, clearly, concisely, appropriately and intelligently
  • Foster open communication, speaks with impact, listens to others and writes effectively
  • Experience with alternate management methods using SSH, serial connections and the command-line interface TMSH
  • Ability to effectively negotiate with vendors on upgrades and acquisitions
  • Expert level IT security processes and controls knowledge as well as IT infrastructure and networking technical knowledge
  • Ability to approach problems with an open-mind and create new and innovative ideas and methods
  • Advanced technical writing
  • Experience in documentation tools such as Visio and Microsoft Office products
  • Advanced information security standards/frameworks (i.e., NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001) skills
  • Advanced experience with Network and VLAN segmentation

Work Experience & Education

  • 3-5 years of experience in large and complex business environments with a successful track record working directly with senior level management preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following domains: Cybersecurity, Information Security, Network Engineering, or Network Operations, Information Technology, Application Development preferred
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • Bachelor’s Degree in related field or equivalent work experience strongly preferred

Licenses and Certifications

  • One or more security related certifications, such as CISSP, CCNP-Security, GIAC, CEH, or CPTS highly preferred

What We Offer: Generous benefits package available on day one to include: 401K matching, bonding leave for new parents (12 weeks, 100% paid), tuition assistance, training, GM employee auto discount, community service pay and nine company holidays.

Our Culture: Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Compensation: Competitive pay and bonus eligibility.

Work Life Balance: Hybrid work environment, 4-days a week in office

NOTE: We are unable to consider candidates who require visa sponsorship for this position

This position is not open to agency submissions

Job Description

The Senior Info Security Engineer implements and supports security solutions and technologies to protect data/assets from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, destruction, modification, or disruption. Provides project leadership, security oversight, and risk management on security projects. Sets security design guidelines, frameworks, and models. Works to identify new security issues and risks and is involved in developing mitigation plans. Help identify and document security objectives. Participates in projects that develop new intellectual property. Trains/mentors members of the team. Build relationships and trust across the organization. Evaluates and recommends new and emerging security products and technologies. Works to develop and interpret security policies and procedures. Supports acquisition and vendor risk assessment due diligence. Leads the building, deployment, and maintenance of security tools utilized by the insider threat program. Proactively seeks solutions to mitigate risk and clearly communicate risks to the appropriate stakeholders.

Basic Skills/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Advanced technical and functional subject matter expert knowledge across security domain areas


Required Skills/Experience:

  • Strong networking knowledge including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPN, load balancing, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) or equivalent Network Access Control (NAC) platforms, including 802.1X, RADIUS, TACACS+, profiling, policy, and authentication troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Ivanti Secure Access / Pulse Secure or equivalent enterprise VPN and secure remote-access technologies, including authentication, routing, certificates, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Netskope Private Access (NPA), SSE, or equivalent Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) platforms, including application access, policy, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting experience, including networking, services, logs, patching, certificates, and command-line diagnostics.
  • Experience integrating security platforms with Active Directory, Entra ID, or equivalent directory/identity services, including SAML, MFA, PKI, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Experience supporting highly available, geographically distributed security infrastructure, including upgrades, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, and capacity planning.
  • Experience with packet capture and advanced network troubleshooting.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues spanning network, Linux, identity, authentication, cloud, and application layers.


Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Experience with Datadog, Splunk, or equivalent monitoring, observability, SIEM, and log analytics platforms.
  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Azure networking or equivalent cloud platforms and cloud-hosted security solutions.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow change, incident, and problem management.
  • Experience with large-scale platform migrations, upgrades, or technology modernization.
  • Relevant Cisco, Microsoft Azure, Linux, or security certifications.


Location expectations:

In office hub 3 or more days per week.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

  • Basic term and optional term life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Pregnancy disability and parental leave
  • 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan
  • Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)
  • Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities
  • Adoption assistance
  • Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

Job Description

The Senior Info Security Engineer implements and supports security solutions and technologies to protect data/assets from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, destruction, modification, or disruption. Provides project leadership, security oversight, and risk management on security projects. Sets security design guidelines, frameworks, and models. Works to identify new security issues and risks and is involved in developing mitigation plans. Help identify and document security objectives. Participates in projects that develop new intellectual property. Trains/mentors members of the team. Build relationships and trust across the organization. Evaluates and recommends new and emerging security products and technologies. Works to develop and interpret security policies and procedures. Supports acquisition and vendor risk assessment due diligence. Leads the building, deployment, and maintenance of security tools utilized by the insider threat program. Proactively seeks solutions to mitigate risk and clearly communicate risks to the appropriate stakeholders.

Basic Skills/Experience:



-  Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
-  5+ years of relevant experience
-  Advanced technical and functional subject matter expert knowledge across security domain areas


Required Skills/Experience:



-  Strong networking knowledge including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPN, load balancing, and troubleshooting.
-  Experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) or equivalent Network Access Control (NAC) platforms, including 802.1X, RADIUS, TACACS+, profiling, policy, and authentication troubleshooting.
-  Experience with Ivanti Secure Access / Pulse Secure or equivalent enterprise VPN and secure remote-access technologies, including authentication, routing, certificates, and connectivity troubleshooting.
-  Experience with Netskope Private Access (NPA), SSE, or equivalent Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) platforms, including application access, policy, and connectivity troubleshooting.
-  Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting experience, including networking, services, logs, patching, certificates, and command-line diagnostics.
-  Experience integrating security platforms with Active Directory, Entra ID, or equivalent directory/identity services, including SAML, MFA, PKI, and certificate-based authentication.
-  Experience supporting highly available, geographically distributed security infrastructure, including upgrades, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, and capacity planning.
-  Experience with packet capture and advanced network troubleshooting.
-  Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues spanning network, Linux, identity, authentication, cloud, and application layers.


Preferred Skills/Experience:



-  Experience with Datadog, Splunk, or equivalent monitoring, observability, SIEM, and log analytics platforms.
-  Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, or infrastructure automation.
-  Experience with Azure networking or equivalent cloud platforms and cloud-hosted security solutions.
-  Familiarity with ServiceNow change, incident, and problem management.
-  Experience with large-scale platform migrations, upgrades, or technology modernization.
-  Relevant Cisco, Microsoft Azure, Linux, or security certifications.

Job Type

Full-time

Description

Elevate your career with Detroit Defense/Athenix Special Missions. Join a dynamic team dedicated to national security through cutting-edge technology. Detroit Defense/Athenix Special Missions has a long history of supporting the Department of War (DOW) in all areas including Engineering, Training, Combat Vehicle Integration, Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, and Software Development. Your journey to impactful work and rapid growth starts now—Behind the Mission Beyond the Challenge!

Detroit defense/Athenix Special Missions seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Cyber Security Engineer (Splunk) ZT to support our Government customer.

This Cyber Security Engineer (Splunk) ZT will support the UEBA and SOAR implementation for the Zero Trust initiative at U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM). In this role, you will help integrate the DoW Visibility and Analytics pillar with the Automation and Orchestration pillar, providing Tier 2 and Tier 3 engineering and technical support to the customer.

This is a full-time position working at MacDill AFB, Tampa FL. This position is not open to remote work.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Work with the customer and other support contracts to support timely and reliable integration of Zero Trust efforts.
  • Work collaboratively with ISSOs and key stakeholders on the RMF process.
  • Develop and maintain RMF artifacts and support the ATO lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with Cybersecurity SMEs to identify requirements and process improvements.
  • Assist cybersecurity assessors as required.
  • Interpret and apply DISA STIG requirements.
  • Act as a member of a team, supporting teammates and collaborating with a “do what it takes” attitude to ensure product and team success.
  • Perform hands-on assessments of enclave and network infrastructure devices.
  • Ensure quality and timeliness of your own work, escalate issues as needed, and contribute to periodic performance reports.
  • Provide input on best practices and procedures.
  • Help develop new and refine existing processes to enhance quality and productivity.

Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Software Engineering or other similar field.
  • Must have a current Active TS/SCI clearance. Only applicants with a current, active TS/SCI will be considered.
  • A minimum of five years of experience in an enterprise and/or cybersecurity-focused environment.
  • Experience with Splunk administration and engineering.
  • Working knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) operations and configurations.
  • Experience with Splunk telemetry integration, workflow engineering, and tuning.
  • Proficiency with Unix and Windows environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Splunk certifications such as Splunk Core Certified Power User, Splunk Core Certified Advanced Power User, Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Analyst, Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Engineer, or Splunk Enterprise Certified Admin
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages (e.g., Bash, Python, Java, Perl, .NET)
  • Familiarity with developing and deploying operational and security use cases within Splunk
  • Familiarity with DoW & NSA Zero Trust Guidance
  • Familiarity with the DoW RMF ATO process and answering controls
  • Familiarity with USSOCOM SOFNET

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
  • Occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, or to communicate with co-workers, management, and customers via email, phone, or virtual communication, which may involve delivering presentations.

Detroit Defense/Athenix Special Missions offers an impressive compensation and benefits package including:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Benefits
  • Company Paid Life and AD&D
  • Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Flexible Spending & HSA Accounts
  • Legal & ID Shield Services
  • 401k with Company Match
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

Why Detroit Defense

At Detroit Defense/Athenix Special Missions, we deliver mission-critical solutions that enhance national security, protect the warfighter, and enable readiness through innovation, technical excellence, and end-to-end lifecycle support.

Remaining steadfast in our core values of Trustworthy, Mission Driven, Creative, and Agile we are a complex systems integrator for the U.S. Government, Detroit Defense/Athenix Special Missions provides solutions to meet the technical and programmatic challenges faced by our customers. Our proven success in multi-domain cross-platform system-of-systems integration results in fielded capability for warfighters. From R&D to production, fielding, and sustainment, Detroit Defense/Athenix Special Missions provides services and solutions to Empower Those That protect Us.

Veterans Encouraged to Apply: Detroit Defense/Athenix Special Missions proudly supports those who have served. We welcome applicants with military experience, including those transitioning to civilian careers. Your leadership, adaptability, and mission-focused mindset are valued here.

Detroit Defense/Athenix Special Missions is a proud recipient of the Hire Vets Gold Medallion Award since 2022.

Detroit Defense/Athenix Special Mission Services is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including gender identity or gender expression), age, mental or physical disability, creed, ancestry, citizenship, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, medical condition, genetic trait or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Salary Description

155,000

Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Security Engineers who are passionate about building automated controls, cloud security architecture, and DevSecOps solutions to join our team. As a Security Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major technical transformations and securing enterprise platforms across Capital One.

What You’ll Do:

  • Architect, engineer, and deploy enterprise-grade IAM frameworks by utilizing advanced data engineering and programmatic automation to build resilient, high-availability identity solutions.
  • Analyze data requirements and requests from management, define operational problems, and develop models and frameworks for validation and problem solving.
  • Lead the design and delivery of technology platforms and automated controls across cloud and on-prem environments
  • Present complex data analysis concepts to diverse audiences in non-technical areas in clear and concise terms
  • Develop advanced automation for vulnerability management, detection, and compliance monitoring
  • Partner with software, cloud and infrastructure teams to embed security by design into enterprise platforms
  • Evaluate and integrate new security technologies, ensuring interoperability and operational scalability
  • Influence and codify engineering standards, patterns, and reusable modules
  • Participate in ongoing support of security tools, including investigations, analysis and break fix

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED or Equivalent Certification
  • At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity or information technology
  • At least 3 years of experience working in a cloud-based environment
  • At least 2 years of experience designing and implementing automated security solutions

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 3+ years of development and operations experience in SailPoint ISC
  • 3+ years of experience building specialization and expertise in a focused discipline of cybersecurity
  • 4+ years of experience with CI/CD security integration, infrastructure as code, or serverless computing
  • 5+ years of development and operations experience in SailPoint IdentityIQ
  • 5+ years of experience with security tools such as IAM, endpoint, vulnerability management or network security technologies
  • 6+ years of experience in cloud or infrastructure security engineering

  • One or more professional certifications: CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, CIDPRO or GIAC Cloud Security

descriptionHtml:
Redwood Credit Union is seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for establishing and implementing security policies, practices, technologies and tools to protect Redwood Credit Union’s critical information resources across cloud, network, and application & infrastructure security, with a focus on Identity & Access management, Incident Response and Security Engineering. Collaborate with architects, engineers, developers, internal audit, lines of business, and management to ensure efficient and effective security controls are in place and maintained in a continually changing technology environment. In addition, promote information security awareness throughout the company to engage team members, with a focus on continually improving security posture by following industry best practices and meeting internal, Member, and regulatory needs.

Key Responsibilities

Security Engineering

  • Select, implement, and support security tools and systems for preventative, detective, and analysis purposes
  • Conduct regular security assessments, red/purple team pen-tests with external vendors and with internal tooling
  • Provide high-level security engineering across application security, network security, cloud security and infrastructure security domains
  • Design, implement, and monitor security controls against CIS v8.1 /NIST CSF 2.0
  • Develop advanced threat hunting and analytic rules, playbooks, connectors and automations. Build in advanced threat intel into detection rules and analytics
  • Manage SIEM and alerting, being the last line of escalation for alerts, leading investigations alerting across all security stack products

descriptionHtml:
United Wholesale Mortgage (UWM) is seeking a skilled Threat and Vulnerability Engineer to help protect our digital assets, data, and infrastructure from evolving cyber threats. This role identifies, assesses, prioritizes, and supports remediation of vulnerabilities across networks, applications, cloud environments, and endpoints. The ideal candidate brings strong security expertise, a proactive mindset, and a commitment to continuously improving UWM’s security posture.

At UWM, we prioritize innovation and security in all our operations. As the Threat and Vulnerability Engineer, you will play a critical role in strengthening our security stance and safeguarding our systems and data. If you are a passionate security practitioner with a strong background in threat and vulnerability management, we invite you to apply and contribute to our mission of delivering secure and trustworthy solutions in the mortgage industry.

This position is not eligible for employer-sponsored work authorization, either now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Vulnerability Management:
    • Conduct regular and ad-hoc vulnerability scans across UWM's IT environment (servers, workstations, network devices, cloud platforms, web applications).
    • Analyze scan results, identify false positives, and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, severity, and potential business impact.
    • Assist with optimization of vulnerability management tools and platforms, ensuring accurate and comprehensive coverage.
  • Threat Intelligence & Research:
    • Stay current with the latest cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and industry best practices.
    • Research and evaluate new tools, technologies, and methodologies to enhance UWM's security stance.
    • Contribute to threat modeling exercises for new and existing systems.
  • Remediation & Collaboration:
    • Work closely with IT operations, development teams, and other stakeholders to communicate vulnerability findings and guide remediation efforts.
    • Track remediation progress, validate fixes, and report on the overall vulnerability management lifecycle.
    • Develop and implement security controls and processes to mitigate identified risks.
  • Reporting & Documentation:
    • Generate clear and concise reports on vulnerability status, remediation efforts, and security posture for various audiences.
    • Maintain accurate documentation of security processes, procedures, and configurations.
  • Incident Response Support:
    • Assist the Security Operations Center (SOC) and Incident Response teams during security incidents, providing expertise on vulnerability context and potential attack vectors.
What We Need From You

Must Have Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in information security, with a strong focus on vulnerability management, penetration testing, or security engineering.
  • Solid understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP), operating systems (Windows, Linux), and common enterprise applications.
  • Proficiency with industry-standard vulnerability scanning tools.
  • Experience with web application security testing tools and understanding of the OWASP Top 10.
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles and practices (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Knowledge of common security frameworks and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, GLBA).
  • Scripting skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and analysis.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Nice To Have Qualifications

  • Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, OSCP, CEH, CompTIA Security+, GIAC certifications such as GSEC, GWAPT, GPEN).
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps principles and integrating security into the CI/CD pipeline.
  • Experience in the financial services or mortgage industry.

THE PLACE & THE PERKS

Ready to join thousands of talented team members who are making the dream of home ownership possible for more Americans? It’s all happening on UWM’s campus, where our award-winning workplace packs plenty of perks and amenities that keep the atmosphere buzzing with energy and excitement.

It’s no wonder that out of our six pillars, People Are Our Greatest Asset is number one. It’s at the very heart of how we treat each other, our clients and our community. Whether it’s providing elite client service or continuously striving to improve, our pillars provide a pathway to a more successful personal and professional life.

From the team member that holds a door open to the one that helps guide your career, you’ll feel the encouragement and support on day one. No matter your race, creed, gender, age, sexual orientation and ethnicity, you’ll be welcomed here. Accepted here. And empowered to Be You Here.

More Reasons You’ll Love Working Here Include

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) after just 30 days
  • Additional parental and maternity leave benefits after 12 months
  • Adoption reimbursement program
  • Paid volunteer hours
  • Paid training and career development
  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • 401k with employer match
  • Mortgage discount and area business discounts
  • Free membership to our large, state-of-the-art fitness center, including exercise classes such as yoga and Zumba, various sports leagues and a full-size basketball court
  • Wellness area, including an onsite urgent care, full-time massage therapist and hair salon 
  • Gourmet cafeteria featuring homemade breakfast and lunch
  • Convenience store featuring healthy grab-and-go snacks
  • In-house Starbucks and Dunkin
  • Indoor/outdoor café with Wi-Fi

All the above duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation and change. All job requirements listed indicate the minimum level of knowledge, skills and/or ability deemed necessary to perform the job proficiently. Team members may be required to perform other or different job-related duties as requested by their team lead, subject to reasonable accommodation. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise. Employment with UWM is "at-will." UWM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. descriptionHtml:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our team in Chantilly, VA.

The Senior Cyber Security Engineer will leverage their strong technical background, PKI expertise, and identity management knowledge to support mission-critical cyber security solution delivery, testing, and system deployment across secure classified enterprise networks.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Maintaining operations of identity and access management services including directory services, user access controls, identity lifecycle workflows, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and privileged access management.
  • Engineering, deploying, and maintaining Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) systems, digital certificates, cryptographic protocols, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) solutions.
  • Maintaining critical infrastructure across Linux and Windows server environments in virtualized, on-premises, and cloud architectures.
  • Performing routine and scheduled Linux and Windows operating system upgrades, security patches, baseline configurations, and system hardening.
  • Managing Continuous Monitoring (CONMON) activities, vulnerability mitigations, and compliance reporting to maintain enterprise Authority to Operate (ATO).
  • Providing structured status updates, technical documentation, and cross-functional coordination within an Agile and collaborative operational framework.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of additional experience in lieu of a degree
  • 5+ years of professional experience
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience supporting and maintaining Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), digital certificate lifecycle management, and authentication/authorization protocols.
  • Hands-on system administration experience working across enterprise Linux and Windows operating systems in classified or unclassified environments.
  • Working knowledge of directory services, LDAP/Active Directory administration, user account management, and database structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement automation scripts or workflow tracking solutions to optimize operational processes and system maintenance.
  • Must have or be willing to obtain an IAT Level II certification within 3 months of hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with configuration of Information Security Corp. (ISC) PKI products (CertAgent and CCMS)
  • Direct experience implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise PKI management tools and digital certificate services.
  • Familiarity with configuration management, automation playbooks, or scripting platforms such as Ansible or PowerShell.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating within Agile, DevOps, or cross-functional technical teams.
  • Prior military or Department of Defense operational background supporting mission-critical IT infrastructure, network security, and compliance workflows.

Clearance Requirements

  • An active TS/SCI with Polygraph is required.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, and technical equipment.
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering technical briefings and operational updates. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
