Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About The Job

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build.

EY focuses on high-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities.

Practice Description

In today's fast-evolving cybersecurity landscape, businesses across all sectors rely on us to provide reliable solutions to their growingly intricate risks and vulnerabilities. As part of our Cyber Threat and Vulnerability Management (TVM) team you will play a pivotal role in achieving this objective. You will assist our clients in understanding and contextualizing their cybersecurity threats, as well as in evaluating, enhancing, and developing their security operations to counter these threats effectively. Leveraging both your technical expertise and business acumen, you will contribute significantly to our mission, making a global impact on cybersecurity.

The opportunity

Cybersecurity threats, the proliferation of social media, extensive data storage demands, stringent privacy laws, and the necessity for uninterrupted business operations all mandate robust information security strategies. In the role of an information security specialist, you will spearhead the deployment of cutting-edge security solutions for our clients, aiding them in safeguarding their enterprises. You will be an integral part of a globally interconnected team of experts dedicated to addressing our clients' most challenging information security issues, thereby enhancing their organizational resilience. Collaborating with our Advanced Security Centers, you will have access to the most advanced tools to combat cybercrime effectively.

EY commits to your professional growth through comprehensive, ongoing training and coaching, ensuring the development of your skills throughout your career. As a leading global service provider in this field, you will collaborate with top-tier professionals in a supportive environment. Joining EY means embarking on a journey where, regardless of how long you're with us, the exceptional EY experience will enrich your professional life forever.

What To Expect

Our security experts are distinguished by their broad industry insights, exceptional technical know-how, and specialized abilities. They maintain their cutting-edge relevance by continuously uncovering the latest security vulnerabilities, engaging with leading security conferences globally as attendees and speakers, and disseminating their knowledge across a range of subjects to essential industry bodies. Through a mix of conventional and innovative means—including conference presentations, white paper publications, and blogging—our team consistently leads in providing thought leadership and fostering information sharing.

Together, our professionals engage in a collaborative process to strategize, execute, and oversee projects aimed at evaluating, enhancing, and, in certain instances, managing our clients' comprehensive security operations. This teamwork ensures the provision of advanced, integrated security solutions tailored to our clients' specific needs.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional client services with a focus on Advanced SIEM Platforms. Monitor project progress diligently, manage potential risks, and keep key stakeholders updated on progress and expected outcomes. Stay informed about the latest business and industry trends, especially those relevant to cybersecurity and the client's business.
  • Build and maintain strong business relationships with client personnel, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in the implementation and management of solutions.
  • Demonstrate technical expertise and professional knowledge. Show an eagerness to absorb new knowledge and adapt to emerging technologies in cybersecurity.
  • Exhibit strong business acumen with an understanding of the strategic importance of SIEM technologies in protecting the client's business operations.
  • Stay updated on the latest advancements in advisory services capabilities and broader industry knowledge.
  • Apply a thorough understanding of complex information systems, leveraging your expertise in the current IT environment and industry trends to identify issues in client engagements. Effectively communicate these insights to both the engagement team and client management through clear written correspondence and articulate verbal presentations.
  • Possess a thorough understanding of the incident response process and familiarity with frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK to enhance threat detection and response capabilities.
  • Platform Administration & Architecture: Maintain, scale, and troubleshoot distributed Splunk environments, including indexers, search heads, heavy/universal forwarders, and deployment servers.
  • Data Onboarding & Ingestion: Connect and parse logs from Windows/Linux hosts, cloud services (AWS/Azure), network gear, and security tools using syslog, APIs, and agents. Normalize data via the Splunk Common Information Model (CIM).
  • Content & Detection Engineering: Write and optimize Search Processing Language (SPL) queries, correlation searches, automated alerts, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Performance & Health Optimization: Monitor system capacity, storage utilization, index retention policies, and search performance.
  • Collaboration & Support: Partner with Security Operations Centers (SOC), network teams, and compliance auditors to investigate data gaps and tune out false positives.
  • Standardize Splunk forwarder deployment, configuration and maintenance across a variety of platforms

To qualify for the role you must have

  • A Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 4 years of related work experience, or a Master’s degree and approximately 3 years of related work experience in the fields of Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related major.
  • A minimum of 1 year of related work experience with information security systems, including hands-on SIEM technical infrastructure and implementation experience.
  • Knowledge of general security concepts and methods, such as vulnerability assessments, privacy assessments, intrusion detection, incident response, the MITRE ATT&CK Framework, security policy creation, enterprise security strategies, architectures, and governance.
  • Experience in leading process definition, workflow design, and process mapping, with an emphasis on integrating SIEM and SOAR capabilities into business operations.
  • An understanding of networking (TCP/IP, OSI model), operating system fundamentals (Windows, UNIX, mainframe), security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, etc.), and application programming/scripting languages (C, Java, Perl, Shell).
  • Technical Experience: hands-on IT or cybersecurity experience specifically administering Splunk Enterprise / Enterprise Security.
  • Query & Scripting Languages: Proficiency in SPL, plus scripting/automation via Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Experience troubleshooting logging, data-ingestion, integration, and monitoring issues.
  • Experience supporting SIEM infrastructure upgrades, patching, testing, and implementation activities.
  • Systems & Networking: Strong working knowledge of Linux/Windows administration, TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, and syslog protocols.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Splunk Enterprise Certified Admin, Splunk Enterprise Certified Architect, CompTIA Security+, or CISSP
  • A valid driver's license in the US and a valid passport are required.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Experience implementing and building SOAR Capability
  • Experience with Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
  • Understanding of AI Security tools
  • Prior Consulting Experience
  • Experience with programming in Python, C, Java, Perl, Shell and/or bash shell scripting.
  • Familiarity with REST API best practices and usage
  • Familiarity with security technologies (Cloud, DLP, firewalls, IDS/IPS, EDR, etc.) and other SOAR products (Falcon Fusion, Splunk SOAR, Google Chronicle SecOps, LogicApps, Sentinel, etc.)
  • CISSP, CISM, CISA, CIPT, CIPM, CRISC or other relevant certification desired

What We Look For

We’re interested in intellectually curious people with a genuine passion for cyber security. With your expertise with advanced SIEM platforms, we’ll turn to you to speak up with innovative new ideas that could make a lasting difference not only to us – but also to the industry as a whole. If you have the confidence in both your presentation and technical abilities to grow into a leading expert here, this is the role for you.

What We Offer

  • Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  • Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  • Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $77,500 to $140,900. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $92,900 to $160,500. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
  • Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
  • Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. 

EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1-800-EY-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

Healthcare is complex. We’re here to change that.

RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.

Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.

As part of our RVO Health Security team, you will play a major part in strategic initiatives that improve our security posture and protect our sensitive data. You will work in a collaborative Agile environment, working closely with the business, IT, and engineering teams. You will apply your skills in a highly dynamic, innovative, cloud-native environment with a strong security-minded culture.

Where You'll Be

Location: Charlotte Metro Area (Fort Mill, SC) | Hybrid

We believe great collaboration happens when we're together, solving problems, learning from each other, and connecting as a team. That's why we’re in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week. You are welcome to work remotely Mondays and Fridays if you wish.

Office address: 1101 Red Ventures Dr Fort Mill, SC 29707

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls and architectures to protect the company's cloud infrastructure, applications, and data from cyber threats.
  • Improve our cloud security posture and vulnerability management program — pull-request scanning, triage and tracking of findings to closure across engineering teams, and coverage and license optimization.
  • Build and enforce software supply chain controls across the developer toolchain — package, dependency, and extension guardrails, with enforcement thresholds tuned to reduce noise rather than generate it.
  • Extend security into CI/CD pipelines, including the emerging problem of governing AI-authored code at the pipeline chokepoint.
  • Build automation, internal tooling, and integrations against our developer platform and security stack so that security controls are self-service rather than ticket-driven.
  • Partner with Platform & Software Engineering teams to create visibility and awareness of security issues and work to prioritize their resolution in a collaborative way.
  • Perform security assessments, including code reviews and application security testing, to identify and mitigate risk in new and changing systems.
  • Participate in a weekly on-call rotation for managed detection and response escalations; investigate potential threats, respond to security incidents, and perform root cause analysis.
  • Develop and maintain security standard operating procedures and policies in accordance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, NIST CSF).
  • Stay informed of the latest developments in tactics, techniques, and procedures related to application and infrastructure vulnerabilities — especially in the healthcare space — and adapt the strategy or tooling to address new threats.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related field OR equivalent experience
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in application security, cloud security, or a related cybersecurity role.
  • Solid understanding of cloud security principles, architectures, and services (AWS or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud security posture management or CNAPP tooling (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud), and a track record of driving vulnerability findings to closure with engineering teams.
  • Experience building security automation, tooling, and integrations, with working proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language.
  • Working knowledge of secure coding practices.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks, standards, and regulations (e.g., NIST CSF, HIPAA, MITRE ATT&CK).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think critically and make sound decisions.
  • Experience in incident response and recovery.

Preferred

  • Professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GIAC).
  • Expertise in AWS security controls, monitoring, and orchestration (SCPs, GuardDuty, Config, Macie, etc.)
  • Working familiarity with Terraform, GitHub, and DevSecOps workflows — particularly securing GitHub Actions and other CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience securing AI- or LLM-assisted development workflows, or reviewing AI-generated code at scale.
  • Experience with internal developer platforms or portals (e.g., Backstage).
  • Experience working alongside an MDR or managed SOC provider.

  • Starting Salary: $100,000 - $130,000*
  • Note actual salary is based on geographic location, qualifications and experience
  • Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision)
  • Life Insurance
  • Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Paid Time Off
  • Holiday Pay
  • 401(k) with match
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program
  • Pharmacy Benefits
  • Income Protection Plans
  • Pet Services Plans
  • Mental Health Support
  • Wellness Coaching
  • HSA- Health Savings Account
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Gym & Fitness Center Discount Program

Who We Are

RVO Health is a health-technology company created through a joint venture between Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group’s Optum. Together, we’ve brought some of the most trusted names in healthcare under one roof, including Healthline, Healthgrades, Fullspan Health, Medical News Today, Optum Perks, and more. We're the #1 source for doctor search in the U.S. Every day, people turn to our brands in moments that matter to find reliable health information, connect with doctors, save money on prescriptions, and take meaningful action on their wellbeing.

RVO Health is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or any other basis protected by law. Employment at RVO Health is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. This includes providing reasonable accommodation where appropriate. Should you require a reasonable accommodation to apply or participate in the job application or interview process, please contact accommodations@rvohealth.com.

We do not provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

descriptionHtml:
Austin Industries is one of the nation’s largest, most diversified U.S.-based construction companies. With more than 8,000 employee-owners, Austin Industries provides nearly every type of civil, commercial and industrial construction services through the expertise of our operating companies: Austin Bridge & Road, Austin Commercial and Austin Industrial.

Austin Industries has an outstanding opportunity for a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer at our corporate headquarters in Dallas, Texas. Under the direction of the Director of Cybersecurity, the Senior Cybersecurity Engineer is a critical member of the Cybersecurity team, responsible for designing, implementing, improving, and maintaining security controls and solutions that protect the organization’s information systems, networks, cloud environments, and data assets.

This role serves as a technical authority on cybersecurity engineering and works closely with IT Helpdesk, Operations, Infrastructure, and business teams to reduce cyber risk, improve organizational resiliency, and support regulatory, compliance, and business objectives.

The position requires deep technical expertise, strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities, and a proactive, threat‑driven mindset. The ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional customer service skills and the ability to translate security requirements into scalable, reliable, and operationally effective solutions that align security initiatives with business needs. The role also requires the highest ethical and professional standards, with a strong emphasis on trustworthiness, reliability, and accountability.

Responsibilities

Security Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls across on‑premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Engineer and support security solutions supporting endpoint protection, identity and access management (IAM), network security, data protection, and cloud security.
  • Lead secure architecture reviews for new systems, applications, and infrastructure initiatives to ensure security requirements are integrated by design.
  • Evaluate, select, and implement cybersecurity tooling, including EDR/XDR, SIEM, DLP, CASB, email security, and vulnerability management platforms.

Threat Detection & Incident Support

  • Develop, tune, and maintain threat detection mechanisms aligned with threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
  • Support security incident response activities, including investigation, containment, eradication, remediation, and post‑incident analysis; participate in recurring incident response drills and tabletop exercises.
  • Partner with SOC, IT Operations, and Infrastructure teams to improve detection accuracy, response effectiveness, and mean time to resolution.

Vulnerability & Risk Management

  • Lead vulnerability management efforts, including vulnerability scanning, risk‑based prioritization, remediation guidance, and validation of fixes.
  • Perform technical risk assessments and contribute to formal enterprise risk register entries.
  • Assist with threat modeling and security assessments of critical business systems and infrastructure.

Cloud & Identity Security

  • Secure cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure, AWS) using native security capabilities and industry best practices.
  • Implement and manage identity‑centric security controls, including MFA, Conditional Access, and Privileged Access Management (PAM).
  • Administer, support, and advance Zero Trust and passwordless authentication initiatives.
  • Compliance & Governance Support
  • Provide technical expertise in support of cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as CIS, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800‑171, CMMC, and ISO/IEC 27001.
  • Support audits, assessments, and third‑party security questionnaires by providing technical evidence, system documentation, and control explanations.
  • Ensure implemented security controls align with documented policies, standards, and procedures.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted cybersecurity technical advisor to IT leadership, technology teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Mentor cybersecurity analysts and junior engineers; contribute to technical standards, procedures, and engineering best practices.
  • Develop knowledge base documentation and deliver periodic training to Helpdesk staff to support first‑level cybersecurity troubleshooting and triage.
  • Communicate complex cybersecurity concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or Cyber Security from an accredited university desired but not required.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing security controls in enterprise environments.
  • Experience implementing, administering and supporting enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions
  • Experience implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise SIEM/XDR platforms.
  • Experience implementing, administering, and supporting SOAR solutions across security operations environments.
  • Hands‑on experience with scripting and security automation, using tools such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Puppet, or agentic AI–driven automation platforms.
  • Experience implementing or supporting compliance initiatives aligned to frameworks such as NIST 800‑171, CMMC, or similar regulatory standards.
  • Experience implementing or supporting cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including CIS Controls, NIST SP 800‑53, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST‑CSF).
  • Familiarity with penetration testing methodologies and tooling, including practical experience conducting or supporting offensive security assessments.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Strong investigation and research skills
  • Deep understanding of modern security architectures and Zero Trust principles.
  • Knowledge and understanding of current penetration testing methodologies and techniques
  • Strong knowledge of Windows, Linux, networking fundamentals, and security protocols.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work based on risk and business impact.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating across teams.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of hands‑on experience in a Cybersecurity Engineering role
  • Deep expertise in at least three of the following security domains:
    • Endpoint security
    • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
    • Cloud security
    • Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
    • Network security
    • Vulnerability management.
  • Eligible candidates must possess one or more of the following valid certifications:
    • ISC2 CISSP
    • GIAC Security Professional (GSP)
    • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft security platforms, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, Intune, and Purview.
  • Advanced experience managing and supporting enterprise Next‑Gen cloud security solutions, such as Palo Alto Prisma and Zscaler.
  • This role may occasionally be required to travel to remote job sites and office locations on an as-needed basis. Additionally, occasionally travel may be required to attend industry-related conferences and training.
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. Austin Industries is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position.


Benefits & Compensation

We offer excellent benefits including medical, dental, life and disability insurance, and a matching 401K plan. We are proud to be a 100% Employee-Owned Company (ESOP)! To learn more about our employee-ownership structure, please go to https://www.austin-ind.com/our-company/100-employee-owned.

Austin Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

See the “Know Your Rights” poster available in English and Spanish.

About Austin Industries

Austin Industries and its operating companies engage in almost every type of civil, commercial and industrial construction. Austin is owned entirely by its employees through its Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Austin Industries has a rich history. We are one of the largest and most diversified construction firms in the nation. Austin stands on the core values of Uncompromising Integrity, Employee-ownership, Exemplary Service and Excellence in Safety.

To learn more about our history, culture and operations, visit us at www.austin-ind.com.

No Third-Party Inquiries Please

This Company does not accept and will not consider unsolicited resumes or any other unsolicited candidate information submitted to the Company or any of its employee-owners by staffing agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters in response to a posted vacancy. The Company will not pay any placement fee(s) without a written agreement to do so (i.e., payment must be required pursuant to the terms of a written agreement).

Any unsolicited resumes or candidate information submitted to this Company or any of its employee-owners becomes the property of the Company.

If you are a job seeker with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to apply for one of our jobs or have accessibility concerns, please contact the People Services Team at (877) 831-1217.

Austin Industries is one of the nation’s largest, most diversified U.S.-based construction companies. With more than 8,000 employee-owners, Austin Industries provides nearly every type of civil, commercial and industrial construction services through the expertise of our operating companies: Austin Bridge & Road, Austin Commercial and Austin Industrial.

Austin Industries has an outstanding opportunity for a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer at our corporate headquarters in Dallas, Texas. Under the direction of the Director of Cybersecurity, the Senior Cybersecurity Engineer is a critical member of the Cybersecurity team, responsible for designing, implementing, improving, and maintaining security controls and solutions that protect the organization’s information systems, networks, cloud environments, and data assets.

This role serves as a technical authority on cybersecurity engineering and works closely with IT Helpdesk, Operations, Infrastructure, and business teams to reduce cyber risk, improve organizational resiliency, and support regulatory, compliance, and business objectives.

The position requires deep technical expertise, strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities, and a proactive, threat‑driven mindset. The ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional customer service skills and the ability to translate security requirements into scalable, reliable, and operationally effective solutions that align security initiatives with business needs. The role also requires the highest ethical and professional standards, with a strong emphasis on trustworthiness, reliability, and accountability.

Responsibilities

Security Engineering & Architecture



- Design, implement, and maintain security controls across on‑premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
- Engineer and support security solutions supporting endpoint protection, identity and access management (IAM), network security, data protection, and cloud security.
- Lead secure architecture reviews for new systems, applications, and infrastructure initiatives to ensure security requirements are integrated by design.
- Evaluate, select, and implement cybersecurity tooling, including EDR/XDR, SIEM, DLP, CASB, email security, and vulnerability management platforms.

Threat Detection & Incident Support



- Develop, tune, and maintain threat detection mechanisms aligned with threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
- Support security incident response activities, including investigation, containment, eradication, remediation, and post‑incident analysis; participate in recurring incident response drills and tabletop exercises.
- Partner with SOC, IT Operations, and Infrastructure teams to improve detection accuracy, response effectiveness, and mean time to resolution.

Vulnerability & Risk Management



- Lead vulnerability management efforts, including vulnerability scanning, risk‑based prioritization, remediation guidance, and validation of fixes.
- Perform technical risk assessments and contribute to formal enterprise risk register entries.
- Assist with threat modeling and security assessments of critical business systems and infrastructure.

Cloud & Identity Security



- Secure cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure, AWS) using native security capabilities and industry best practices.
- Implement and manage identity‑centric security controls, including MFA, Conditional Access, and Privileged Access Management (PAM).
- Administer, support, and advance Zero Trust and passwordless authentication initiatives.
- Compliance & Governance Support
- Provide technical expertise in support of cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as CIS, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800‑171, CMMC, and ISO/IEC 27001.
- Support audits, assessments, and third‑party security questionnaires by providing technical evidence, system documentation, and control explanations.
- Ensure implemented security controls align with documented policies, standards, and procedures.

Collaboration & Leadership



- Serve as a trusted cybersecurity technical advisor to IT leadership, technology teams, and business stakeholders.
- Mentor cybersecurity analysts and junior engineers; contribute to technical standards, procedures, and engineering best practices.
- Develop knowledge base documentation and deliver periodic training to Helpdesk staff to support first‑level cybersecurity troubleshooting and triage.
- Communicate complex cybersecurity concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or Cyber Security from an accredited university desired but not required.
- Proven experience designing and implementing security controls in enterprise environments.
- Experience implementing, administering and supporting enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions
- Experience implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise SIEM/XDR platforms.
- Experience implementing, administering, and supporting SOAR solutions across security operations environments.
- Hands‑on experience with scripting and security automation, using tools such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Puppet, or agentic AI–driven automation platforms.
- Experience implementing or supporting compliance initiatives aligned to frameworks such as NIST 800‑171, CMMC, or similar regulatory standards.
- Experience implementing or supporting cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including CIS Controls, NIST SP 800‑53, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST‑CSF).
- Familiarity with penetration testing methodologies and tooling, including practical experience conducting or supporting offensive security assessments.
- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
- Strong investigation and research skills
- Deep understanding of modern security architectures and Zero Trust principles.
- Knowledge and understanding of current penetration testing methodologies and techniques
- Strong knowledge of Windows, Linux, networking fundamentals, and security protocols.
- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
- Ability to prioritize work based on risk and business impact.
- High attention to detail.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work independently while collaborating across teams.

Requirements  



- Minimum 5 years of hands‑on experience in a Cybersecurity Engineering role
- Deep expertise in at least three of the following security domains:

- Endpoint security
- Identity and Access Management (IAM)
- Cloud security
- Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
- Network security
- Vulnerability management.
- Eligible candidates must possess one or more of the following valid certifications:

- ISC2 CISSP
- GIAC Security Professional (GSP)
- Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft security platforms, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, Intune, and Purview.
- Advanced experience managing and supporting enterprise Next‑Gen cloud security solutions, such as Palo Alto Prisma and Zscaler.
- This role may occasionally be required to travel to remote job sites and office locations on an as-needed basis. Additionally, occasionally travel may be required to attend industry-related conferences and training.
- Applicants must be legally authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. Austin Industries is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position.
 

Benefits & Compensation

We offer excellent benefits including medical, dental, life and disability insurance, and a matching 401K plan. We are proud to be a 100% Employee-Owned Company (ESOP)! To learn more about our employee-ownership structure, please go to https://www.austin-ind.com/our-company/100-employee-owned.

Austin Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

See the “Know Your Rights” poster available in English and Spanish.

About Austin Industries

Austin Industries and its operating companies engage in almost every type of civil, commercial and industrial construction. Austin is owned entirely by its employees through its Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Austin Industries has a rich history. We are one of the largest and most diversified construction firms in the nation. Austin stands on the core values of Uncompromising Integrity, Employee-ownership, Exemplary Service and Excellence in Safety.

To learn more about our history, culture and operations, visit us at www.austin-ind.com.

No Third-Party Inquiries Please

This Company does not accept and will not consider unsolicited resumes or any other unsolicited candidate information submitted to the Company or any of its employee-owners by staffing agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters in response to a posted vacancy. The Company will not pay any placement fee(s) without a written agreement to do so (i.e., payment must be required pursuant to the terms of a written agreement).

Any unsolicited resumes or candidate information submitted to this Company or any of its employee-owners becomes the property of the Company.

Accessibility Note

If you are a job seeker with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to apply for one of our jobs or have accessibility concerns, please contact the People Services Team at (877) 831-1217.

Company Overview

XCEL Engineering, Inc. is an award-winning small business that provides trusted information technology, engineering, consulting and project management solutions and services to federal agencies and organizations. Originally founded in 1971 by professional engineers at the University of Tennessee, XCEL was acquired in 2003 by U.S. Army and Navy veterans and in 2023 became a MartinFed company.

XCEL Engineering is a part of IT Lab Partners (ITLP) which was created to support a leading research facility in the East Tennessee region in recruiting the best and the brightest technical talent. Considering joining our impressive team today!

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cybersecurity Engineer - Vulnerability & Security Monitoring to support enterprise cybersecurity operations across complex, mission-critical computing environments. This position is responsible for administering, maintaining, and enhancing enterprise vulnerability management, security monitoring, and event logging capabilities to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information systems.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive hands-on experience with Tenable Security Center, enterprise SIEM platforms, vulnerability assessment, log management, and security automation, along with a strong understanding of federal cybersecurity requirements.

This role requires a technically proficient engineer capable of troubleshooting complex security technologies, analyzing vulnerabilities and security events, developing automated solutions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to strengthen the organization's overall security posture across classified and unclassified environments.

Essential Functions

Vulnerability Management & Assessment

  • Administer, configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise vulnerability management platforms, primarily Tenable Security Center (Tenable.sc).
  • Manage vulnerability scanning infrastructure, including scanner deployment, scan policies, scheduling, credential management, plugin updates, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Conduct comprehensive vulnerability assessments across diverse enterprise computing environments, including servers, networks, applications, and infrastructure systems.
  • Analyze vulnerability scan results to validate findings, identify false positives, assess severity, and prioritize remediation efforts based on risk and operational impact.
  • Troubleshoot failed scans, scanner connectivity issues, credential failures, performance limitations, and detection anomalies.
  • Collaborate with system administrators, infrastructure teams, and security personnel to develop remediation strategies, track vulnerabilities, and verify corrective actions.
  • Engage directly with vendors, including Tenable, to resolve technical issues, investigate inaccurate findings, and validate software updates or detection improvements.
  • Develop vulnerability reports, dashboards, and metrics to communicate security risks, remediation progress, and overall program effectiveness.

Security Information & Event Management (SIEM) / Logging

  • Administer, configure, maintain, and enhance enterprise SIEM and centralized security logging platforms.
  • Design, implement, and troubleshoot log collection architectures, event collectors, processing pipelines, indexing systems, and data ingestion workflows.
  • Develop and maintain ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to collect, normalize, transform, and integrate security event data from multiple enterprise sources.
  • Integrate logs from operating systems, network devices, applications, security tools, and infrastructure platforms to improve enterprise security visibility.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot log ingestion failures, parsing errors, data quality issues, and system performance concerns.
  • Collaborate with system owners and cybersecurity teams to ensure logging and auditing practices align with NIST SP 800-53 Audit and Accountability (AU) controls across multiple classified enclaves.
  • Identify gaps in logging coverage and implement enhancements to improve threat detection, incident investigation, and security monitoring.
  • Develop and optimize security event searches, correlation rules, dashboards, and reporting capabilities to support threat hunting and incident response.
  • Coordinate with software and technology vendors to resolve SIEM platform issues and improve logging capabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Significant professional experience in cybersecurity engineering, vulnerability management, security monitoring, or enterprise security operations.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Tenable Security Center (Tenable.sc) or comparable enterprise vulnerability management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of vulnerability scanning methodologies, credentialed scanning, vulnerability validation, risk assessment, and remediation processes.
  • Hands-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting enterprise SIEM and centralized logging solutions.
  • Experience with log collection, ingestion pipelines, event processing, indexing, parsing, and security event analysis.
  • Knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, and security log normalization.
  • Experience supporting security monitoring, incident response, threat analysis, or security investigations.
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53, particularly Audit and Accountability (AU) controls, and federal cybersecurity compliance requirements.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues across enterprise operating systems, networks, applications, and security technologies.
  • Ability to develop or maintain scripts and automated workflows using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams and communicate cybersecurity risks to stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • US Citizen with an active Department of Defense (DoD) TS, Department of Energy (DOE) Q security clearance or equivalent.
  • Bachelors degree in computer science, information assurance or related technical field with 7+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity operations within Department of Defense (DoD), Department of Energy (DOE), or other federal government environments.
  • Experience working within classified computing environments or multiple security enclaves.
  • Advanced knowledge of Tenable Security Center, Nessus scanners, scan policy development, and vulnerability reporting.
  • Experience with enterprise SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Elastic Security, IBM QRadar, or similar technologies.
  • Experience designing or maintaining custom log ingestion pipelines, data transformations, and automated security workflows.
  • Familiarity with Linux and Windows system administration, enterprise networking, and infrastructure security.
  • Experience with security automation, REST APIs, system integrations, and scripting.
  • Knowledge of NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), continuous monitoring, and federal information security requirements.
  • Experience supporting threat hunting, detection engineering, security analytics, or incident response activities.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CASP+/SecurityX, CISSP, GIAC, or equivalent cybersecurity credentials.

Physical Requirements & Environmental Conditions

  • Inside office environment.
  • Working on a computer for long periods of time.
  • May involve long period of sitting at a desk.

Other Duties

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Xcel Engineering is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, religious creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, transgender, pregnancy, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability, protected Veteran Status, genetics or any other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Xcel Engineering's current openings as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by calling 855.212.1810. Thank you for your interest in Xcel Engineering.

All positions at Xcel Engineering, Inc. are contingent upon passing both a background check and drug screening prior to a start date and are subject to random drug screenings during the employment period. In addition, Xcel Engineering is an E-Verify employer.

Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.


Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

ㅤ

*Must work a hybrid model (3 days onsite) out of our Silver Spring, DC, or Atlanta office.*


Your New Role:
 

          The WBD Security Engineering team empowers the WBD Global Information and Content Security (GICS) teams by supporting the Security Engineering, Security Architecture, Threat Detection and Response, and other Security teams/functions through the deployment, management, and maintenance of shared, reliable, and extensible security platforms/systems. The Cybersecurity engineer plays a key role on the GICS security engineering team, ensuring that security best practices are followed and that tools and processes that support a secure platform are maintained and kept current. Ideal candidates will have a mixture of security and systems engineering backgrounds to ensure that business processes are configured correctly and that security best practices are designed and implemented.

The ideal Cybersecurity candidate is expected to:

• Implement design reviews to evaluate security controls.

• Identify and communicate opportunities to enhance the security posture of WBD.

• Build and / or manage enterprise security platforms effectively.

• Communicate effectively across all levels of management to articulate WBD security goals and vision.


Your Role Accountabilities:

  • Plan, design, engineer and implement security-related technologies
  • Understanding technical security issues, their implications within WBD business units and able to effectively communicate them to management and other business leaders.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain security infrastructure – including software and hardware in cloud environments, as well as on-premises.
  • Conduct security audits and assessments to regularly determine the effectiveness of security platforms and identify areas of improvement.
  • Host and operating systems hardening, auditing, monitoring and logging with appropriate security controls and best practices while meeting security best practices and business goals.
  • Research and explore emerging security technologies and determine their appropriate use within the company.
  • Prepare, document, and create standard operating procedures and protocols. Crosstrain and mentor other team members as needed.


Qualifications & Experiences:

  • A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience in building, designing, and maintaining enterprise security tools

  • A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering

  • 5+ years of successfully implementing advanced cyber security technology in a complex environment

  • Engineer and administer security platforms including SIEM/SOAR systems, endpoint detection and response, vulnerability management, anomaly detection, and cloud analysis.

  • Hands on technical experience with networking and computing system architectures, specifically, the security aspects thereof.

  • Must have 5+ Leveraging DevSecOps and secure architecture design principles to develop security capabilities.

  • Must have 5+ Linux system administration

  • ​Must have 5+ scripting experience (using Python or other equivalent languages)

  • Thorough understanding of information security principles, techniques, principles, policy frameworks, and best practices

  • ​ ​Hands-on Experience in public cloud infrastructures like AWS (Amazon Web Services)

  • Hands on experience with Kubernetes and helm.

  • A minimum of 3+ Hands-on Experience with automation technologies (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, etc.)

Not Required but preferred experience:

  • Security and Cloud certifications are a plus. (CISSP, Splunk Admin, AWS Solution architect)
  • Hands on technical experience with compliance and regulatory frameworks and how they affect architecture designs and review.
  • AI Engineering or AI security.


About Skydance

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.


Some Important Details

We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

Hiring Salary Range: $91,000.00 - $169,000.00 per year

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing compensation, or a range thereof, for roles where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, external market data, internal equity, skill set, experience, training, education, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of our total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation.

About Firefly Aerospace

Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Our launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles provide government and commercial customers with full mission services from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.

Summary

As a Cybersecurity Engineer II at Firefly, your primary responsibility is designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security measures across our Linux and macOS environments. You will own the security posture of our Unix-based endpoint and server fleet — hardening configurations, managing vulnerabilities, and responding to threats — while also extending secure practices into our cloud infrastructure and containerized environments. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to safeguard our data and systems against cyber threats, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

Responsibilities

  • Linux & macOS Security (Primary Duty):
  • Develop, implement, and maintain security policies and procedures for Linux and macOS systems, ensuring alignment with compliance standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and NIST.
  • Conduct regular security assessments and vulnerability scans across Linux and macOS endpoints and servers, implementing patches and hardened configurations to mitigate risk.
  • Monitor security tooling and Linux/macOS system logs for suspicious activity; analyze security incidents and respond promptly to contain and remediate threats.
  • Manage endpoint protection, device compliance, and configuration baselines across the Linux and macOS fleet.
  • Kubernetes and Containerization Security:
  • Secure Kubernetes clusters using best practices, including RBAC, network policies, and pod security standards.
  • Manage and secure containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes), ensuring integrity of container images and registries.
  • Monitor and remediate vulnerabilities within container environments.
  • Security Monitoring and Incident Response:
  • Monitor security tools and systems for alerts and events; investigate and respond to incidents.
  • Develop and maintain incident response plans and playbooks, with regular drills.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders during incident response.
  • Documentation and Compliance:
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of security policies, procedures, and configurations, with emphasis on Linux/macOS environments.
  • Support security audits and assessments with necessary documentation and evidence.
  • Stay current on emerging threats, technologies, and regulatory requirements, adapting strategies accordingly.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in information security engineering, with a strong, demonstrated focus on Linux and macOS security.
  • Proficiency in Linux/Unix/macOS operating systems, including security configurations, hardening, and best practices.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms, including security best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Desired

  • Certifications such as CISSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), or similar.
  • Experience with compliance frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and PCI-DSS.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure), including security services and configurations.
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, Chef) and infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and their security considerations.
  • Experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) monitoring tools and incident response processes.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, protocols, and security measures.
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and integrating security into CI/CD pipelines.

Firefly offers outstanding benefits for our employees, including generous health, dental and vision plans with low plan deductibles, parental leave, relocation benefits, educational reimbursement, short term disability, and flexible PTO options.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

The engineer will collaborate with technical teams to develop secure, scalable solutions and transition capabilities into operations. Flexible remote, hybrid, and onsite work arrangements are available, based on program requirements. Occasional travel may be required.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, configure, and integrate cloud security capabilities, including EDR/XDR, CSPM, SIEM, SOAR, WAF, vulnerability management, and cloud-native security services.
  • Engineer scalable security architectures and technical controls for Microsoft Azure, AWS, and hybrid-cloud environments.
  • Design and implement security logging, detection rules, telemetry collection, dashboards, and automated security capabilities required to support effective security monitoring and response.
  • Design and configure Web Application Firewall (WAF) architectures, policies, and baseline rule sets to protect internet-facing applications and services.
  • Engineer and integrate Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) capabilities to identify cloud security vulnerabilities, configuration weaknesses, and compliance gaps.
  • Design and implement identity and access security controls, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), privileged access, service identities, and least-privilege access models.
  • Engineer vulnerability management capabilities and processes supporting the identification, prioritization, remediation, and validation of vulnerabilities across cloud infrastructure, applications, and workloads.
  • Develop scripts, automation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to support repeatable security deployments, configuration management, compliance validation, and security control implementation.
  • Integrate security requirements and controls into cloud infrastructure, operating systems, applications, containers, and supporting services.
  • Integrate cybersecurity capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows to enable automated security testing and validation throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain cloud security architectures, technical procedures, system diagrams, configuration standards, engineering documentation, and operational runbooks.
  • Define technical requirements, configuration baselines, acceptance criteria, and transition artifacts necessary to move security capabilities from engineering into operational environments.
  • Support testing and validation of security capabilities prior to operational transition, ensuring solutions meet defined cybersecurity, performance, and compliance requirements.
  • Conduct knowledge transfer and technical transition activities with operations personnel as capabilities mature and are prepared for operational ownership.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineers, infrastructure engineers, application teams, cybersecurity personnel, and operations teams to identify security requirements and engineer appropriate technical solutions.


Qualifications

Required Skills/Experience:

  • Minimum of two (2) years of professional experience designing, implementing, or securing Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or hybrid-cloud environments; five (5) or more years of relevant cloud security experience is preferred.

  • Experience designing and configuring Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions to protect internet-facing applications and services.
  • Experience implementing and integrating Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and cloud security capabilities within Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Experience engineering security controls supporting vulnerability management, infrastructure hardening, logging, threat detection, and security automation within enterprise cloud environments.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access management (IAM), Zero Trust principles, least-privilege access, and cloud security best practices.
  • Experience with cloud-native and enterprise security technologies such as Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, AWS GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub, Azure Web Application Firewall, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience developing technical documentation, configuration standards, procedures, and transition artifacts supporting the handoff of engineered capabilities into operational environments.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD IAT Level II or higher certification (e.g., Security+, CISSP, or equivalent).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance.

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. Four (4) years of relevant cybersecurity experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Experience developing security automation and integrating security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps principles and secure software development practices.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and security considerations for containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity requirements, including Risk Management Framework (RMF), Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and applicable NIST security controls.
  • Experience developing engineering documentation, operational procedures, and technical transition packages.
  • Experience supporting the transition of technical capabilities from engineering/development teams to operations teams.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum engineering environments.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex cloud security and integration issues.

Description

Larson Financial Holdings LLC is seeking a proven Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to build and drive cybersecurity initiatives with an ownership mindset. The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer plays a critical role in protecting the organization's information systems, data and infrastructure.

The role builds and improves security tools, automation and policies, including using AI tools to connect security platforms and produce monitoring dashboards. It also supports the day-to-day administration of cybersecurity operations: threat monitoring, incident response, compliance initiatives and security awareness. The role researches security improvements and implements them.

As a member of the Larson Technology Services team, the Senior Cybersecurity Engineer also contributes to broader technology operations as needed, in a collaborative environment where team members support one another across technology functions to keep our services reliable and effective.

Key Responsibilities

Security engineering and tool development

  • Design and build security controls across endpoint, identity, network and cloud environments, including Microsoft Azure and Entra ID.
  • Research and evaluate new security tools; develop recommendations, business cases, proofs of concept and vendor assessments; and deploy and configure the tools selected.
  • Build detection logic, automation and response playbooks.
  • Perform threat modeling and security reviews for new systems, changes and projects, and recommend mitigations.
  • Develop and improve security baselines and hardening standards.
  • Integrate security tooling to reduce manual work, such as automating phishing triage, phishing campaign reporting and vulnerability ticketing.
  • Use AI tools, APIs and low-code automation to connect security and SaaS platforms (for example EDR, vulnerability management, phishing simulation, Microsoft 365, Entra ID and ticketing) and consolidate their data.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports for security monitoring, including vulnerability, phishing, incident and compliance metrics, using AI-assisted development and visualization tools.
  • Use AI tools in line with organizational policy and data-handling requirements and recommend safeguards for AI use within the security environment.

Cybersecurity operations

  • Monitor, investigate and respond to security alerts and incidents, including phishing emails, malware alerts and unauthorized access attempts.
  • Administer and maintain security tools, including endpoint detection and response (EDR) and vulnerability scanners.
  • Remediate security incidents, conduct follow-up analysis, document findings and actions taken, and recommend process improvements based on lessons learned.
  • Manage and respond to phishing reports submitted by staff; coordinate containment and communication; and tune detections and build automation to reduce false positives and manual triage.
  • Perform regular vulnerability assessments, and work with system owners and end users to prioritize and remediate identified risks.
  • Contribute to the planning and rollout of new cybersecurity objectives, tools and initiatives as the security program evolves.

Security awareness and phishing simulations

  • Plan and run recurring phishing simulation campaigns, including setup, scheduling and distribution.
  • Analyze campaign results and identify departments or individuals who need additional training or follow-up.
  • Develop and deliver security awareness communications, training materials and coaching based on simulation outcomes and leadership direction.
  • Maintain records of simulation results and awareness training completion to support reporting and continuous improvement.
  • Recommend improvements to the security awareness program, including training content, success metrics and risk-based targeting.

Compliance and risk management

  • Support day-to-day efforts to achieve and maintain compliance with applicable security controls.
  • Conduct periodic control assessments, gather evidence and work with stakeholders to close compliance gaps.
  • Draft and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, risk assessments and control inventories.
  • Map security controls to applicable frameworks and recommend control improvements.
  • Conduct risk assessments and recommend remediation priorities.
  • Support internal and external audits and regulatory examinations by preparing evidence packages and responding to inquiries.
  • Identify emerging risks and recommend policy or control improvements.

Technology operations and service support

  • Provide systems administration support as assigned, including user account management, access provisioning, Conditional Access policies and endpoint configuration.
  • Assist with service desk escalations that require elevated access or advanced troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with Larson Technology Services colleagues on infrastructure projects, applying a security-first perspective to system design and change management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on cybersecurity engineering experience, including at least 3 years at a senior or specialist level.
  • Proven experience owning security compliance work aligned to frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or CIS Controls, including audit preparation and evidence management.
  • Deep experience architecting, deploying and optimizing security tools such as EDR/XDR and vulnerability management platforms, including tuning, policy design and integration across the environment.
  • Advanced proficiency building automation and tooling with scripting languages such as PowerShell and Python to reduce manual effort and improve security operations.
  • Strong experience with SIEM and detection engineering, including developing and tuning detection rules, correlating data sources and mapping detections to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Experience applying AI tools and APIs to connect systems, automate workflows and build dashboards or reports, with sound judgment about data handling and risk.
  • Extensive hands-on experience designing and securing Microsoft Azure and Entra ID environments, including Conditional Access, identity governance, privileged access management and cloud security posture.
  • Experience authoring and maintaining security policies, standards and procedures, and driving their adoption across business and technical teams.
  • Experience running phishing simulation platforms and security awareness programs, including measuring effectiveness and reporting on outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead incident investigations and response, and to communicate findings and risk clearly to technical teams, executives and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to evaluate security solutions, build business cases and present well-supported recommendations to management and leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple competing priorities independently, balancing strategic projects with operational responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience mentoring and providing technical guidance to technology staff.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, GCIH, CompTIA Security+, CEH, or Microsoft SC-200 or AZ-500.
  • Experience with security architecture reviews, risk assessments, or third-party and vendor risk management.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code or DevSecOps practices.
  • Familiarity with financial services regulatory requirements, such as SEC and FINRA cybersecurity expectations, Regulation S-P and GLBA.

Larson is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other character protected by law.
